模糊暗物质孤子碰撞产生的引力波

Gravitational Waves from Collisions of Fuzzy Dark Matter Solitons

Chen Tan, Jing-Kang Bin, Ke Wang · astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.GA, hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：根据薛定谔-泊松（SP）方程，模糊暗物质（FDM）可以形成稳定的平衡结构，即FDM孤子。SP系统也可描述FDM孤子的演化，例如正碰。本文首先提出新的无量纲长度、时间和质量单位，然后用PyUltraLight模拟无量纲SP系统，在线性理论有效且忽略引力波对FDM孤子演化的反作用时，研究FDM孤子碰撞产生的引力波。最后发现，当FDM质量分别为m=10^{-18}eV/c^2或m=10^{-17}eV/c^2时，碰撞产生的引力波频率为（几十纳年）^{-1}或（几年）^{-1}量级；因此未来对此类引力波的探测将约束FDM粒子和孤子的性质。

English: According to the Schr\"odinger-Poisson (SP) equations, fuzzy dark matter (FDM) can form a stable equilibrium configuration, the so-called FDM soliton. The SP system can also determine the evolution of FDM solitons, such as head-on collision. In this paper, we first propose a new adimensional unit of length, time and mass. And then, we simulate the adimensional SP system with $\mathtt{PyUltraLight}$ to study the GWs from collision of FDM solitons when the linearized theory is valid and the GW back reaction on the evolution of FDM solitons is ignored. Finally, we find that the GWs from collisions have a frequency of (few ten-years)$^{-1}$ or (few years)$^{-1}$ when FDM mass is $m=10^{-18}\rm{eV}/c^2$ or $m=10^{-17}\rm{eV}/c^2$. Therefore, future detection of such GWs will constrain the property of FDM particle and solitons.

一句话导读：用无量纲薛定谔-泊松模拟研究模糊暗物质孤子碰撞产生的低频引力波及其对FDM参数的约束意义。

星系团约束下费米子暗物质混合中子星的贝叶斯推断

Bayesian Inference of Fermionic Dark Matter Admixed Neutron Stars Informed by Galaxy Cluster Constraints

H. C. Das, J. B. Wei · astro-ph.HE, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：自相互作用暗物质在星系和星系团尺度上受到每单位质量弹性散射截面 σ/mχ～0.1-10 cm^2/g 的约束。作者将该截面纳入非对称、自相互作用费米子暗物质组分的状态方程，并在双流体框架下对暗物质混合中子星进行贝叶斯推断，取 σ/mχ=0.1、1、10 cm^2/g。对七个核物质参数以及暗粒子质量和质量分数进行采样，并与核理论和中子星观测对照。结果表明核部分与整体观测量在整个截面范围内统计上不可区分；数据将暗物质质量限制在约1.45-1.88 GeV，质量分数约0.05-0.09，具体依赖截面。比较相同参数抽取但仅截面不同的运行，发现截面会明显改变重子半径，但仅对轻暗物质，而该区域被天文数据大多排除。因此自相互作用并非弱到不可见，但其效应隐藏在现有观测已不利的参数区域。

English: Self-interacting dark matter is constrained on galactic and cluster scales by its elastic scattering cross section per unit mass, $\sigma/m_\chi \sim 0.1-10\ {\rm cm^2/g}$. We incorporate this cross section into the equation of state of an asymmetric, self-interacting fermionic dark matter component and perform a Bayesian inference of dark matter admixed neutron stars in the two-fluid framework at $\sigma/m_\chi = 0.1$, $1$ and $10\ {\rm cm^2/g}$. Seven nuclear matter parameters are sampled together with the dark particle mass and mass fraction, and confronted with nuclear theory and neutron star observations. The nuclear sector and the global observables are statistically indistinguishable across the whole range of cross sections, while the data constrain the dark matter mass to $m_\chi \simeq 1.45-1.88$~GeV and its mass fraction to $f_\chi \simeq 0.05-0.09$, depending on the cross section. Finally, comparing runs built from the same parameter draws, so that only the cross section differs, we find that it does change the baryonic radius appreciably, but only for light dark matter, a region the astrophysical data largely disfavor. The self-interaction is therefore not too weak to be seen; however its effect is hidden in the region of parameter space that the present observational data already disfavor.

一句话导读：用贝叶斯推断和双流体框架约束自相互作用费米子暗物质混合中子星，发现截面效应被现有观测不利的轻暗物质区域掩盖。

旋转带电Bumblebee黑洞中的粒子动力学：与Kerr-Newman的解析对应

Particle dynamics in rotating charged Bumblebee black holes: An analytical correspondence with Kerr-Newman

Xiaowei Li, Deyou Chen, Chuang Yang · gr-qc, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：本文建立了慢旋转带电Einstein--Bumblebee黑洞时空中无自旋与自旋检验粒子的赤道面动力学与有效Kerr--Newman时空之间的解析对应。对于自旋粒子，该对应在Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon框架下通过适当的参数匹配建立。我们表明，对应圆轨道具有相同的半径和坐标角速度，而其径向动力学与局部不稳定率表现出依赖于洛伦兹破坏的标度行为。然而，该对应并不意味着完全动力学等价，因为轨道轨迹和每方位角周期内的径向扰动增长通常不同。这些结果通过区分参数匹配下保持的动力学性质与被洛伦兹破坏径向形变修改的性质，界定了有效Kerr--Newman对应的适用范围与局限。

English: In this paper, we establish an analytical correspondence between the equatorial dynamics of spinless and spinning test particles in a slowly rotating charged Einstein--Bumblebee black hole spacetime and those in an effective Kerr--Newman spacetime. For spinning particles, the correspondence is established within the Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon framework under appropriate parameter matching. We show that corresponding circular orbits have identical radii and coordinate angular velocities, while their radial dynamics and local instability rates exhibit a Lorentz-violation-dependent scaling. Nevertheless, the correspondence does not imply complete dynamical equivalence, as orbital trajectories and radial perturbation growth over an azimuthal period generally differ. These results delineate the scope and limitations of the effective Kerr--Newman correspondence by distinguishing the dynamical properties preserved under parameter matching from those modified by the Lorentz-violating radial deformation.

一句话导读：该文给出旋转带电Bumblebee黑洞中检验粒子动力学与有效Kerr-Newman时空的解析对应，并指出洛伦兹破坏导致径向动力学不完全等价。

相关度：medium — 论文属于经典引力与黑洞时空中的检验粒子动力学，并非全息研究；与用户的经典引力/广义相对论支线相关，但与全息超导、纠缠等主线距离较远。

五维涡旋时空中的黑洞天体

Black objects in a five-dimensional swirling spacetime

Adriano Vigan\`o · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：本文利用五维 Ernst 方程的 Ehlers 对称性，将 Myers-Perry 黑洞和旋转黑洞环嵌入五维涡旋时空。作者表明这两个解均可消除锥形奇点，并且涡旋会修改黑洞环的平衡条件。文中计算了视界面积、表面引力和 Komar 荷，它们满足 Smarr 关系，并研究了能层区域。

English: We use the Ehlers symmetry of the five-dimensional Ernst equation to embed the Myers-Perry black hole and the rotating black ring in a five-dimensional swirling spacetime. We show that both solutions can be made free of conical singularities, and that the swirl modifies the balance condition of the black ring. We compute horizon areas, surface gravities and Komar charges, which satisfy a Smarr relation, and study the ergoregions.

一句话导读：利用 Ehlers 对称性在五维涡旋时空中构造并研究 Myers-Perry 黑洞与旋转黑洞环的经典解及其热力学量。

重新审视Majumdar--Papapetrou黑洞的Frolov--Zelnikov解

Revisiting the Frolov--Zelnikov solution for Majumdar--Papapetrou black holes

Jongheon Baek, Gihwan Nam · gr-qc, hep-th, math-ph, math.MP · v3 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：本文重新审视Frolov与Zelnikov给出的多中心Majumdar--Papapetrou时空中试探电荷的静电格林函数，修正其视界电荷条件并推广到高维。在四维中，作者对具有独立指定视界势的最小耦合旁观Maxwell场导出精确的Dirichlet-to-Neumann映射。视界通量电荷满足电容矩阵，其对角元为 C_AA=M_A+∑_{B≠A}M_AM_B/R_AB，非对角元为 C_AB=-M_AM_B/R_AB；该矩阵可写成正对角项加加权图Laplacian，从而给出场能的精确共模/差模分解。接地Dirichlet格林函数通过调和测度将点电荷通量分配到无穷远与各视界。文章指出Frolov--Zelnikov的对角条件仅保持总视界电荷，允许电荷在各视界间重分配；保持每个视界电荷的修正对称格林函数涉及逆电容矩阵。对双中心情形，修正给出有限且负半定的自能移动以及精确的自作用力差，无需额外紫外减除。最后将电容矩阵、通量分配和固定电荷格林函数推广到 D=n+3 维，其中图权重含普适因子 π^{n/2}/Γ(n/2)。

English: We revisit Frolov and Zelnikov's electrostatic Green function for a test charge in a multi-center Majumdar--Papapetrou spacetime, correcting its horizon-charge condition and extending the result to higher dimensions. In four dimensions, we derive the exact Dirichlet-to-Neumann map for a minimally coupled spectator Maxwell field with independently prescribed horizon potentials. The horizon flux charges obey a capacitance matrix with entries $C_{AA}=M_A+\sum_{B\ne A}M_AM_B/R_{AB}$ and $C_{AB}=-M_AM_B/R_{AB}$, where $M_A$ are center masses and $R_{AB}$ their separations. This matrix is a positive diagonal term plus a weighted graph Laplacian, yielding an exact common-mode/differential-mode decomposition of the field energy. The grounded Dirichlet Green function partitions a point charge's flux among infinity and the horizons through harmonic measures. We show that the diagonal condition imposed by Frolov and Zelnikov [Eq.~(4.14)] preserves only the total horizon charge, allowing redistribution between individual horizons. A corrected symmetric Green function preserving each horizon charge instead involves the inverse capacitance matrix. For two centers, the correction produces a finite, negative-semidefinite self-energy shift and an exact self-force difference, without additional ultraviolet subtraction. Finally, we extend the capacitance matrix, flux partition, and fixed-charge Green function to $D=n+3$ dimensions, where the graph weights contain the universal factor $\pi^{n/2}/\Gamma(n/2)$.

一句话导读：修正多中心Majumdar--Papapetrou黑洞静电格林函数的视界电荷条件，给出电容矩阵、通量分配与高维推广。

Lyapunov 控制的热化：一个精确的实时例子

Lyapunov-controlled thermalization: an exact real-time example

Jonas Loy, Jan C. Louw · cond-mat.str-el, hep-th, quant-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：一个在驱动停止后被验证的 Kubo-Martin-Schwinger（KMS）关系，并不足以证明系统达到平衡。我们在 large-N large-q Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（SYK）淬火协议中展示了这一点。尽管淬火后的所有费米子关联函数都严格是热性的，第二次淬火回到初始哈密顿量会揭示初始态的隐藏记忆。该记忆编码在连接第一次淬火之前时间的关联函数中。这种记忆是一个广延的非平衡（NEQ）见证，其衰减率就是 Lyapunov 指数 λ_L。因此，λ_L 决定了态在多大速率上变得实际上与 Gibbs 态不可区分。尽管这是一个幺正相互作用多体系统，完整的 NEQ 实时演化在 large-N、large-q 极限下可以精确获得，使该设置非常适合解析研究热化。

English: A verified Kubo-Martin-Schwinger (KMS) relation, after a drive has ceased, is not sufficient evidence to prove equilibrium. We demonstrate this in a large-$N$ large-$q$ Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) quench protocol. Although all post-quench fermion correlators are exactly thermal, a second quench back to the initial Hamiltonian reveals hidden memory of the initial state. It is encoded in correlators connecting to times before the first quench. This memory is an extensive nonequilibrium (NEQ) witness with its decay rate being the Lyapunov exponent $\lambda_L$. Thus $\lambda_L$ sets the rate at which the state becomes effectively indistinguishable from a Gibbs state. Despite being a unitary interacting many-body system, the complete NEQ real-time evolution is obtained exactly in the large-$N$, large-$q$ limit, making the setup ideal for analytically studying thermalization.

一句话导读：在 large-N large-q SYK 淬火中证明 KMS 热性不保证平衡，并给出由 Lyapunov 指数控制的热化记忆衰减的精确实时描述。

相关度：low — 论文主题是 SYK 淬火中的热化、KMS 关系与 Lyapunov 指数，不直接涉及所列的全息超导、p 波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或探针膜等方向；仅与更广泛的全息/SYK 热化相关。

一般双黑洞并合中视界形成的普适结构

Universal Structure of Horizon Formation in Generic Binary Black Hole Mergers

Yu-Cun Xie, Vaishak Prasad · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：双黑洞并合过程中会形成新的公共表观视界，并产生边缘外陷获面的外层与内层分支。本文推导这些分支的局部结构。该事件发生在完全非线性区域，超出后牛顿旋进理论和稳态黑洞微扰的标准适用范围，却具有普适描述。作者不假设对称性，证明边缘外陷获面的稳定性算符在形成时必须失去可逆性。最外层稳定性进而表明，消失的本征值是主本征值，且对应严格正的本征函数。Lyapunov-Schmidt 约化给出具有共同线性漂移的平方根分支分离。外层与内层公共视界位于光滑的边缘外陷获管上，沿该管切片时间在形成处有局部极小值，附近较晚切片与它相交成外层和内层分支，其间隔按 (t-t_*)^{1/2} 标度。沿主零模具有非零一阶变分的足够光滑准局域标量泛函继承平方根分离和共同线性项。作者在三个双黑洞数值模拟中检验这些预言，包括一个偏心、进动、不等质量系统。三者中世界管几何和准局域标量均遵循预言标度。计入下一阶项后，对表面几何和准局域泛函的自由指数拟合在百分之零点五以内恢复平方根指数 1/2，各诊断对形成时间的符合程度在 5×10^{-5}M 以内。视界剪切与引力波 news 之间的相关性提示，公共视界形成可能在并合波形的短片段中留下特征。

English: A new common apparent horizon forms during a binary black hole merger and gives rise to outer and inner branches of marginally outer trapped surfaces. We derive the local structure of these branches. This event occurs in the fully nonlinear regime, outside the standard regimes of post-Newtonian inspiral theory and perturbations of a stationary black hole, yet it admits a universal description. Without assuming symmetry, we show that the stability operator of the marginally outer trapped surface must lose invertibility at formation. Outermost stability then implies that the vanishing eigenvalue is the principal one, with a strictly positive eigenfunction. Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction yields square-root branch separation with a shared linear drift. The outer and inner common horizons lie on a smooth marginally outer trapped tube along which slice time has a local minimum at formation, and nearby later slices intersect it in outer and inner branches whose separation scales as $(t-t_*)^{1/2}$. Sufficiently smooth quasilocal scalar functionals with nonzero first variation along the principal zero mode inherit the square-root separation and a shared linear term. We test these predictions in three binary black hole simulations, including an eccentric, precessing, unequal-mass system. In all three, the worldtube geometry and quasilocal scalars follow the predicted scaling. With the next-order term included, free-exponent fits to the surface geometry and quasilocal functionals recover the square-root exponent, $1/2$, to within half a percent, and diagnostics agree on the formation time within $5\times10^{-5}M$. The correlation between horizon shear and gravitational-wave news raises the possibility that common horizon formation has a signature in a short segment of the merger waveform.

一句话导读：证明双黑洞并合时公共表观视界形成具有普适的平方根分支结构，并在三个数值模拟中验证。

一个各向异性反弹必须违反多少平均零能量？

How much averaged null energy must an anisotropic bounce violate?

Alan Zhang, Ye Zhou · gr-qc, hep-th, math-ph, math.MP · v4 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：我们证明，在 Einstein 引力中，一个零完备、非静态的 Bianchi I 宇宙（均匀、空间平坦且各向异性）沿每一条完整光线都会违反平均零能量条件（ANEC），至多只有四个零方向例外；若其总能量密度（包括宇宙学常数）曾经为正，则沿所有完整光线都违反。沿每条完整光线，平均零能量至多为 $-J_p/(8\pi G)$，当积分收敛时取等号，其中 $J_p$ 是一束细光线所累积的膨胀与剪切的平方。对于空间截面为 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 的情形，非时序 ANEC 因此只留下 Minkowski 空间，这与平坦和开放 Friedmann 模型相同。在逐点零能量条件下，非静态 Bianchi I 宇宙的每条零测地线都不完备。有效圈量子宇宙学的各向同性反弹给出 $J_p=1.478\,\omega_B H_{\max}$（反弹时光频率乘以最大 Hubble 率），而在相同临界密度下，强各向异性反弹最便宜的光线要付出四到五倍的代价。一个三环面上由 Casimir 效应支撑的转折点具有同量级的亏欠，但在远低于 Planck 尺度的 Hubble 率下，其光线绕环面传播而不是非时序的，因此非时序 ANEC 不适用于它们。

English: We show that in Einstein gravity a null-complete, non-static Bianchi I universe (homogeneous, spatially flat and anisotropic) violates the averaged null energy condition (ANEC) along every complete light ray outside at most four null directions, and along all of them if its total energy density, cosmological constant included, is ever positive. Along each complete ray the averaged null energy is at most $-J_p/(8\pi G)$, with equality whenever the integral converges, where $J_p$ is the squared expansion and shear accumulated by a thin bundle of light rays. With spatial sections $\mathbb{R}^3$ the achronal ANEC therefore leaves only Minkowski space, as for flat and open Friedmann models. Under the pointwise null energy condition, every null geodesic of a non-static Bianchi I universe is incomplete. The isotropic bounce of effective loop quantum cosmology has $J_p=1.478\,\omega_B H_{\max}$ (light frequency at the bounce times largest Hubble rate), and at the same critical density the cheapest ray of a strongly anisotropic bounce pays four to five times as much. A Casimir-supported turning point on a three-torus has a deficit of the same order, but at Hubble rates well below the Planck scale its light rays circumnavigate the torus and are not achronal, so the achronal ANEC does not apply to them.

一句话导读：该文在 Einstein 引力中给出各向异性 Bianchi I 反弹违反平均零能量条件的普适下界，并比较圈量子宇宙学与 Casimir 环面反弹的代价。

一般自旋的双黑洞散射

Binary black hole scattering with generic spins

Adam Clark, Geraint Pratten, Patricia Schmidt · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：我们研究具有轨道平面进动的一般自旋黑洞散射，其动力学需要不止一个散射角。利用数值相对论，我们提取极角散射角以及轨道平面的进动，后者由渐近欧拉角刻画。我们给出将后闵可夫斯基观测量与散射角及欧拉角联系起来的字典，从而实现首次进动情形下的 PM-NR 比较。结果为由一般自旋重求和提供关键基准，并为探索一般情形下的边界到束缚态映射奠定基础。

English: We study generic-spin black-hole scattering with orbital-plane precession, whose dynamics require more than one scattering angle. From numerical relativity (NR), we extract the polar scattering angle and precession of the orbital plane, the latter characterised by asymptotic Euler angles. A dictionary relating post-Minkowskian (PM) observables to scattering and Euler angles is presented, enabling the first precessing PM-NR comparisons. Our results provide a key benchmark for generic-spin resummations and provide the foundations for exploring boundary-to-bound maps in the generic case.

中文摘要：我们提出一个修改引力框架：标准 Einstein 场方程由经典物质部门作为源，该物质部门与一个模拟动态真空基底的 Higgs 型标量场 χ 耦合。通过引入唯象的协变耦合，我们实现一个物理的位移原理，其中大质量重子物质驱动真空场偏离其真空期望值。我们表明，该耦合导致粒子惯性静止质量随场调制，并产生空间第五力，从而在保持基本点质量普遍自由下落的同时，造成局域性的 Einstein 等效原理违反。在弱场非相对论极限下，该相互作用表现为对 Newton 势的 Yukawa 型修正。我们用局域引力约束检验该框架的可行性，包括行星近日点进动和 Eötvös 参数极限。最后，我们建模稳态、非相对论球对称尘埃吸积，证明真空诱导质量调制与第五力加速的竞争效应会产生不同的密度和速度剖面。

English: We present a modified gravitational framework in which the standard Einstein field equations are sourced by a classical matter sector coupled to a Higgs-type scalar field $\chi$ modeling a dynamic vacuum substrate. By introducing a phenomenological covariant coupling we implement a physical displacement principle where massive baryonic matter drives the vacuum field away from its vacuum expectation value. We show that this coupling leads to a field-dependent modulation of a particle's inertial rest mass alongside a spatial fifth force, yielding localized violations of the Einstein Equivalence Principle while preserving universal free fall for fundamental point masses. In the weak-field, non-relativistic limit, this interaction manifests as a Yukawa-type correction to the Newtonian potential. We test the viability of this framework against local gravitational constraints, including planetary perihelion precession and E\"otv\"os parameter limits. Finally, we model the steady-state, non-relativistic spherical accretion of dust, demonstrating that the competing effects of vacuum-induced mass modulation and fifth-force acceleration yield distinct density and velocity profiles.

中文摘要：我们求解了在刚性 AdS2 与 dS2 上的大 N 二维 QCD（含基本夸克），即 't Hooft 模型。其等距变换保持零规范 A_-=0；在仿射坐标中，曲率仅通过零线上的特殊共形生成元进入光前哈密顿量。SL(2,R) Casimir 给出精确介子方程：'t Hooft 方程加上一个符号由曲率决定的 Legendre 算符。在 AdS2 上，该方程与折叠/分段弦及光前全息背景中提出的方程相关。手征极限下 π 介子无质量，并满足固定手征凝聚的 Gell-Mann–Oakes–Renner 关系；一旦通量管超过曲率半径，维数从 Regge 行为过渡到对数增长，而平空间可积结构仍然保留。我们还求解了位于边界处的夸克与反夸克相互作用问题：超过临界耦合后，弦将其拉回边界，产生散射相移。在 dS2 上，由于空间膨胀，介子即使在 N=∞ 也是不稳定共振态并最终解离；其宽度由 de Sitter 温度的 Boltzmann 因子给出。

English: We solve large-$N$ two-dimensional QCD with fundamental quarks---the 't Hooft model---on rigid AdS$_2$ and dS$_2$. Their isometries preserve the null gauge $A_-=0$ and in affine coordinates the curvature enters the light-front Hamiltonian only through the special-conformal generator of the null line. The $SL(2,\mathbb{R)}$ Casimir then results in an exact meson equation: 't Hooft's equation plus a Legendre operator whose sign is determined by the curvature. On AdS$_2$ it is related to equations proposed in the context of folded/segmented strings and light-front holography. The pion is massless in the chiral limit and obeys a Gell-Mann--Oakes--Renner relation that fixes the chiral condensate, the dimensions cross over from Regge to logarithmic growth once the flux tube exceeds the curvature radius, and the flat-space integrable structure survives. We also solve the problem of a quark interacting with an antiquark placed at the boundary: beyond a critical coupling the string pulls it back to the boundary, resulting in a scattering phase. On dS$_2$ and due to the expansion of space, the mesons are unstable resonances even at $N=\infty$ and eventually dissociate. Their widths are given by Boltzmann factors at the de Sitter temperature.

一句话导读：论文在刚性 AdS2/dS2 上精确求解大 N 't Hooft 模型，给出曲率修正的介子方程、手征凝聚关系以及 dS2 中由膨胀导致的不稳定介子共振。

静态与辐射引力子导致的 O(G^4) 机械角动量损失

Lara Bohnenblust, Carl Jordan Eriksen, Gustav Uhre Jakobsen, Kathrin Stoldt, Andrii Yanovets · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：本文使用世界线量子场论（WQFT）确定两个引力散射物体在 O(G^4) 的机械角动量损失 L^μ_loss。引力记忆效应——引力场早时与晚时行为的一种现象——给出对 L^μ_loss 的静态贡献。作者说明其来源：线性记忆通过所谓的静态关联子贡献，而非线性记忆在此阶因对称性考虑而消失。其余动力学部分的计算类似于 O(G^4) 冲量的计算。作者用重新表述的 WQFT 费曼规则生成被积函数，该规则在每一个顶点守恒四动量并清楚显示经典圈。三圈积分被约化为主积分，文中较详细描述了其微分方程以及在 post-Newtonian 极限下的边界匹配。与同阶保守效应不同，这里只出现多重对数函数。尽管动力学部分的个别贡献发散，这些发散在 L^μ_loss 中相消。结果的辐射二次部分重现了早先结果，而完整结果与现有 post-Newtonian 结果一致。

English: We determine the loss of mechanical angular momentum $L^{\mu}_{\rm loss}$ of two gravitationally scattering bodies at $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$ using worldline quantum field theory (WQFT). The gravitational memory effect, a phenomenon of the early- and late-time behaviour of the gravitational field, leads to static contributions to $L^{\mu}_{\rm loss}$. We illuminate how these arise: the linear memory contributes through so-called static correlators, while the nonlinear memory vanishes at this order due to symmetry considerations. The computation of the remaining, dynamical part resembles that of the $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$ impulse. We generate its integrand using a reformulation of the WQFT Feynman rules that conserves four-momentum at every vertex and plainly exhibits the classical loops. The three-loop integrals are reduced to master integrals, whose differential equations and boundary matching in the post-Newtonian limit we describe in some detail. In contrast to conservative effects at this order, only polylogarithms appear. While individual contributions to the dynamical part are divergent, these cancel in $L^{\mu}_{\rm loss}$. The quadratic-in-radiation part of our result reproduces earlier results, while the complete result agrees with existing post-Newtonian results.

一句话导读：用世界线量子场论计算两体引力散射在 O(G^4) 的机械角动量损失，区分静态记忆与辐射贡献并与后牛顿结果一致。

渐近反德西特时空中的替代边界条件

Alternative Boundary Conditions in Asymptotically Anti-de Sitter Spacetimes

Robert M. Wald, Xinkang Wang · hep-th, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v3 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：反德西特时空不是全局双曲的，因此通常需要边界条件才能使动力学良定义。Ishibashi 和 Wald 曾用非局域势与各球谐模确定标量、电磁和线性化引力场的良定义且能量守恒正定的边界条件。本文判定哪些 IW 条件在基本场中是局域的、哪些是 AdS 不变的。在四维时空中，标准 AdS 不变边界条件在共形边界上令电磁场的重标度磁场为零、令爱因斯坦引力的重标度磁外尔张量为零；作者将其推广为令电场与磁场或相应外尔张量的任意线性组合为零，并猜测这些条件穷尽了 AdS_{1,3} 中局域、AdS 不变且保守的边界条件。文中还研究了非 AdS 不变条件及其他维数，并将 AdS_{1,3} 的 AdS 不变条件推广到 Yang-Mills 理论及一般 Fefferman-Graham 设定下的非线性引力。作者为这些一般边界条件构造相空间；一般条件的协变相空间自然联系到含 Pontryagin 项的拉格朗日量，在引力中还联系到 Gauss-Bonnet 项。在引力情形，除标准边界条件外不存在非平凡渐近对称性，ADM 质量等所有守恒荷恒为零，类似闭合宇宙；含包括 AdS 的 Killing 场的时空则在 Fischer-Marsden 与 Moncrief 意义下出现线性化不稳定性。对非标准边界条件，修改后的辛结构给出黑洞熵公式的新表达式。

English: Anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetimes are not globally hyperbolic, so boundary conditions are generally needed for well-defined dynamics. Ishibashi and Wald (IW) determined boundary conditions yielding well-posed dynamics with conserved positive energy for scalar, electromagnetic, and linearized gravitational fields, using nonlocal potentials and individual spherical harmonic modes. In this paper, we determine which IW conditions are local in the primary fields and which are AdS-invariant. In four spacetime dimensions, the standard AdS-invariant boundary conditions set the rescaled magnetic field to zero for electromagnetism and the rescaled magnetic Weyl tensor to zero for Einstein gravity on the conformal boundary. We generalize these standard boundary conditions by setting arbitrary linear combinations of the electric and magnetic fields, or the corresponding Weyl tensors, to zero, and we conjecture that these exhaust the local, AdS-invariant, conservative boundary conditions in AdS$_{1,3}$. Boundary conditions with non-AdS-invariance and in different spacetime dimensions are also studied. The AdS-invariant conditions in AdS$_{1,3}$ extend to Yang-Mills theory and nonlinear gravity in a general Fefferman-Graham setting. We construct phase spaces for these general boundary conditions. The covariant phase spaces for general conditions are naturally associated with Lagrangians containing Pontryagin terms and, in gravity, a Gauss-Bonnet term. In gravity, except for the standard boundary condition, no nontrivial asymptotic symmetries exist and all conserved charges such as ADM mass vanish identically, as in a closed universe. Spacetimes with Killing fields including AdS then exhibit linearization instability in the sense of Fischer and Marsden and Moncrief. For nonstandard boundary conditions, the modified symplectic structure yields new expressions for the entropy formula of black holes.

一句话导读：研究渐近 AdS 时空中标量、电磁与引力场的局域且 AdS 不变边界条件、相空间、渐近对称性及黑洞熵修正。

Connor Behan, Leonardo Pipolo de Gioia · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：给定固定圈阶的超共形规范理论，BPS 态可通过枚举幂零超荷的上同调类或对角化反常维数矩阵来研究。后者可深入考察全息理论如何依据算符对偶于无地平几何还是黑洞来区分算符。为此，作者在 U(N)_k × U(N)_{-k} ABJM 理论中把 N 作为形式参数进行对角化，从而定义算符轨迹，并聚焦于仅在有限多个 N 值为 BPS 的“偶然”算符。与 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中数值研究多个此类轨迹困难不同，ABJM 可访问 16 条此类轨迹及其后代。作者表明这些轨迹在大 N 下形式尤其简单，并与可积性预言一致；许多轨迹如黑洞一样只能由特定类型的引力子修饰，并讨论了该上同调练习对完整算符性质的启示。最后指出，ABJM 中到首个非 BPS 态的能隙与 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论定性不同，且符合预期。

English: Given a superconformal gauge theory at a fixed loop order, BPS states can be studied in two ways --- by enumerating cohomology classes of a nilpotent supercharge or by diagonalizing the anomalous dimension matrix. The second one allows for a deeper look at how holographic theories distinguish between operators based on whether they are dual to horizonless geometries or black holes. To this end, we carry out the diagonalization in $\mathrm{U}(N)_k \times \mathrm{U}(N)_{-k}$ ABJM theory with $N$ as a formal parameter. This makes it possible to define trajectories of operators and focus on the fortuitous ones which are characterized by being BPS at only finitely many values of $N$. In contrast to $\mathcal{N} = 4$ Super Yang-Mills, where it has been numerically prohibitive to study more than one of these, ABJM gives us access to 16 such trajectories along with their descendants. We show that they take an especially simple form at large $N$ where they agree with the predictions of integrability. We also show that many of them, as with black holes, can only be dressed by certain types of gravitons and comment on how this exercise in cohomology also has implications for properties of the full operators. Finally, we show that the gap to the first non-BPS state in ABJM theory qualitatively differs from that of $\mathcal{N} = 4$ Super Yang-Mills in the expected way.

一句话导读：在 ABJM 中构造并研究仅在有限 N 为 BPS 的偶然算符轨迹，揭示其与黑洞对偶及与 N=4 SYM 的差异。

English: Self-dual Einstein gravity is a one-loop exact, UV and IR finite, diffeomorphism invariant, non-unitary theory of quantum gravity in four dimensions. The only generically non-zero amplitudes are the one-loop-all-plus amplitudes, and they are equal to those of pure Einstein gravity. In these notes we review SDG and SDYM pedagogically. We walk the reader through key calculations, fill in some gaps in the literature, and point out directions for future research. Topics include: derivation of the self-dual actions from the full Einstein gravity/YM actions in lightcone gauge, decoupling of ghosts, Berends-Giele currents, vanishing of tree-level-one-minus amplitudes, celestial $\Lw$ symmetry, perturbiners, double-off-shell current calculation of one-loop-all-plus SDYM and SDG amplitudes, dimension shifting, unitarity cuts, the BDPR gravity formula, one-loop color ordering, perturbative dilatation symmetry of SDG, and the covariant formulations of the self-dual theories as well as their their gauge fixing. We also review some selected results from the celestial holography program.

On the Nucleon Effective Mass in Neutron Stars Cooling

Yuuki Sugiyama, Akira Dohi · hep-th, astro-ph.HE, nucl-th · v2 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：中子星冷却强烈依赖超高密度核物质的状态方程，因为主要冷却源是内部中微子产生。本文聚焦核子有效质量对冷却性质的影响；有效质量的不确定性来自标量介子吸引相互作用差异以及Dirac质量与Landau质量定义的不同。作者首先采用可在统一框架中引入这两种质量的Walecka模型，计算中子与直接Urca过程的中微子发射率及冷却曲线，表明Dirac和Landau质量会影响大质量中子星冷却，而以往多数冷却模拟未区分二者。随后使用两个基于相对论平均场理论的实际状态方程进行冷却模拟，二者差异仅来自有效质量相关性质；结果与Walecka模型基本一致，说明核子有效质量的处理可能是中子星冷却不确定性的重要来源。

English: The cooling of neutrons stars, which are composed of ultra-high-density nuclear matter, strongly depends on the equation of state because the dominant cooling sources are neutrinos produced in their interiors. Here, we investigate the cooling properties of neutron stars, focusing on effective nucleon masses, whose impacts have been recently examined in supernova explosion and proto-neutron star cooling. The uncertainties of effective masses originate from the difference in the attractive interaction of scalar meson and the definition of the Dirac and Landau masses. At first, we employ so-called Walecka models that allow these two masses to be introduced within a unified framework and evaluate the resulting cooling curves. Based on the Walecka model, we compute the emissivity of the neutrons and the direct Urca process and their cooling curves. We demonstrate that the Dirac and Landau masses affect cooling of massive neutron stars, although most previous cooling simulations do not distinguish them. We also perform cooling simulations with two realistic equation of states based on relativistic mean-field (RMF) theory, whose differences arise from properties of only effective masses among characteristic parameters. These results are broadly consistent with those obtained from the Walecka models, indicating that the treatment of effective nucleon masses may be an important source of uncertainty in neutron-star cooling.

一句话导读：在Walecka模型和相对论平均场状态方程下，核子Dirac/Landau有效质量差异会改变大质量中子星冷却曲线，是冷却模拟的重要不确定性来源。

English: We explain how to extract thermal OPE coefficients of double-twist operators in scalar two-point functions at infinite spatial volume from suitably regularized integrals of thermal response functions in momentum space. As a specific application, we implement the proposed approach to four-dimensional holographic CFTs with an Einstein bulk action, where the finite-temperature state is captured by an AdS$_5$ black-brane geometry. In that case, the thermal response function can be computed on the gravitational side by solving numerically a radial ODE reduction of the Klein-Gordon equation. 零无穷处恰当可观测量的代数：狄拉克括号、记忆与戈德斯通探针

An algebra of proper observables at null infinity: Dirac brackets, Memory and Goldstone probes

Rodrigo Andrade e Silva, Simone Speziale · hep-th, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v3 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：我们在零无穷处辐射引力模式相空间上，对经典可观测量的狄拉克括号进行严格计算，并自然纳入记忆效应。考虑 Ashtekar-Streubel 相空间，时间边界条件为 news 消失且 shear 为纯电性，并考虑相空间的无穷维性，我们确定了恰当可观测量的代数（恰当可观测量理解为可与光滑辛流相关联的相空间函数）。我们证明超平移荷的作用在 shear 上生成正确变换。我们还证明文献中采用的“Goldstone 模”常规定义不能与恰当可观测量相联系，但存在无穷族恰当可观测量——我们称为 Goldstone 探针——能够测量 Goldstone 模。我们注意到不存在仅由 shear 或 news 构造的 Goldstone 探针，这为迄今构造具有不同记忆态的可分 Hilbert 空间的尝试失败提供了一种可能解释。最后，我们导出局域 shear 与 news 之间分布型狄拉克括号的公式，并证明它们包含非局域修正。

English: We develop a rigorous evaluation of Dirac brackets for classical observables on the phase space of radiative gravitational modes at null infinity that naturally incorporates memory effects. Considering the Ashtekar-Streubel phase space, with boundary conditions in time given by vanishing {\it news} and purely electric {\it shear}, and taking into account the infinite dimensionality of the phase space, we identify the algebra of proper observables (understood as functions on phase space that can be associated with smooth symplectic flows). We show that the action of supertranslation charges generate the correct transformations on the shear. We also show that the conventional definition of the ``Goldstone mode'' adopted in the literature cannot be associated with a proper observable, but nevertheless there exists an infinite family of proper observables, which we call {\it Goldstone probes}, that are capable of measuring the Goldstone mode. We notice that there are no Goldstone probes constructed only out of the shear {\it or} the news, providing a possible explanation for why attempts to construct a (separable) Hilbert space with different memory states have failed so far. Finally, we derive formulas for distributional Dirac brackets between local shear and news, and show that they contain non-local corrections.

一句话导读：在零无穷 Ashtekar-Streubel 相空间上严格定义恰当可观测量代数，并用 Goldstone 探针讨论引力记忆与超平移变换。

Carrollian量子态与平直空间全息

Carrollian quantum states and flat space holography

Stefan Fredenhagen, Stefan Prohazka, Robert Tiefenbacher · hep-th, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v3 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：我们从代数视角研究自由Carrollian量子场论，并探讨其对平直空间全息的含义。作为显式例子，我们由相对论标量场的Carroll极限构造电性与磁性Carrollian Weyl代数，并分析其态，包括真空态与热态。对于有质量电性理论，我们找到一个正则的Carroll不变真空态和一个正则的KMS态，从而给出自洽的Carrollian热力学系统。相比之下，无质量电性理论与磁性理论更为微妙：依赖于量子化方式，它们要么没有正则的 distinguished vacuum，要么只拥有非正则的Carroll不变基态，同时仍支持非正则热态。我们进一步分析无质量电性理论中的替代态类，包括空间均匀的准自由纯态与Sorkin--Johnston态。受这些结果启发，我们讨论其对平直空间全息的后果。我们构造一个与Carrollian全息相关的良定义态，其Hilbert空间表示分解为一个标准Fock部分和一个不可分零模部分，从而突显边界理论中红外自由度所起的作用。

English: We study free Carrollian quantum field theories from an algebraic perspective and explore their implications for flat space holography. As explicit examples, we construct the electric and magnetic Carrollian Weyl algebras obtained from Carroll limits of the relativistic scalar field and analyze their states, including vacuum and thermal configurations. For the massive electric theory, we find a regular Carroll-invariant vacuum state and a regular KMS state, yielding a consistent Carrollian thermodynamic system. By contrast, the massless electric and magnetic theories are more subtle: depending on the quantization, they admit either no regular distinguished vacuum or only nonregular Carroll-invariant ground states, while still supporting nonregular thermal states. We further analyze alternative classes of states in the massless electric theory, including spatially homogeneous quasifree pure states and Sorkin--Johnston states. Motivated by these results, we discuss consequences for flat space holography. We construct a well-defined state relevant for Carrollian holography whose Hilbert-space representation factorizes into a standard Fock sector and a nonseparable zero-mode sector, thereby highlighting the role of infrared degrees of freedom in the boundary theory.

一句话导读：从代数视角构造Carrollian Weyl代数并分析真空/KMS等态，讨论平直空间全息中边界红外零模的作用。

English: We present a closed formula for the computation of static post-Newtonian corrections to the two-body gravitational dynamics at any odd order, assuming the lower-order results are known. 中文摘要：本文在天球上构造一个二维作用量，用于描述四维阿贝尔规范理论与引力理论的红外部分。利用该全息模型，作者重现了四维中超相位旋转与超平移 Goldstone 模式的对跖匹配条件、领头软光子与软引力子定理，以及具有一般 dressing 的 in/out 态的振幅红外因子化。借助红外因子化，作者重现了标准未 dressing 振幅中的红外发散，并表明包含 Faddeev-Kulish dressing 态的振幅是红外有限的。作为推论，该模型构造出一大类使散射振幅红外有限的 dressing 态。

English: We construct a two-dimensional action on the celestial sphere that describes the infrared sector of Abelian gauge and gravitational theories in four dimensions. 中文摘要：本文研究 arXiv:2405.20366 提出的三维 TQFT 对所有拓扑求和与边界二维 CFT 幺正系综之间的精确全息对偶。主要结果是证明该系综中每个成员的权重由以其范畴对称为 SymTFT 时相对于体 TQFT 的可逆对称群给出的对称因子决定；这是描述边界理论的 Lagrangian 代数 groupoid 上自然且在同构意义下均匀的测度。文章还用给定边界三维流形的 Heegaard 分裂等价类更显式地写出拓扑求和并讨论其权重，指出该框架下的全息对偶可视为 Siegel-Weil 公式的推广。文中讨论非紧 TQFT 的含义；在 Virasoro 情形下，这意味着给定中心电荷的所有 CFT 组成的系综按完整可逆对称性加权。最后展示该 TQFT 引力框架如何自然构造 baby universe Hilbert 空间。

English: We study the recent proposal of arXiv:2405.20366 which poses a precise holographic duality between a 3d TQFT summed over all topologies and a unitary ensemble of boundary 2d CFTs. In that proposal, the sum over topologies is obtained via genus reduction from topologies with a large genus boundary Riemann surface, while the boundary ensemble is given by all CFTs described by Lagrangian condensations of the bulk TQFT. The main result of this work is to show that each member of this ensemble is weighted by a symmetry factor given by the invertible symmetry group of its categorical symmetry relative to the bulk TQFT as its SymTFT. This is the natural $\unicode{x2014}$ uniform up to isomorphism $\unicode{x2014}$ measure on the groupoid of Lagrangian algebras that describe the boundary theories. We also write the sum over topologies more explicitly in terms of equivalence classes of Heegaard splittings of 3-manifolds with a given boundary and comment on their weights. The holographic duality in this framework can then be viewed as a generalization of the Siegel-Weil formula. We discuss the implications of the main result for non-compact TQFTs. In particular, for the Virasoro case, this implies an ensemble of all CFTs at a given central charge in which CFTs are weighted by their full invertible symmetry. Finally, we show how this TQFT gravity framework gives a natural construction of the baby universe Hilbert space.

一句话导读：证明 TQFT 引力全息系综中边界 CFT 按可逆对称群自同构因子加权，并构造 baby universe Hilbert 空间。

中文摘要：本文求解全局双曲洛伦兹四维流形上关于带斜对称挠率度量联络平行的不可约实旋量的 Cauchy 问题，证明在显式指出的障碍模掉后适定，并给出此类旋量的初始数据刻画。证明基于旋量形式理论，通过在 Cauchy 超曲面 Σ 上由向量场生成流的旋转拉回作用显式积分旋量与度规的耦合流。将约束方程刻画为显式外微分系统，并用接触结构和平坦叶状结构描述其全部解，在紧致情形给出完全分类；特别地，每个定向紧致三维流形都可作为某个带斜挠率平行旋量的全局双曲洛伦兹四维流形的 Cauchy 超曲面。进一步研究四维 Neveu-Schwarz 超引力在阿贝尔丛 gerbe 上的演化流与其超对称条件决定的旋量演化流的相互作用，证明其适定且相容，从而建立四维超对称 NS 系统的适定性并给出超对称的初始数据刻画；还得到刚性结果：每个具有紧致 Cauchy 超曲面的全局双曲超对称 NS 解都是平坦的且丛 gerbe 曲率为零。

English: We solve the Cauchy problem for an irreducible real spinor parallel with respect to a metric connection with skew-symmetric torsion on a globally hyperbolic Lorentzian four-manifold, proving that it is well-posed modulo an obstruction that we identify explicitly, and obtaining an initial-data characterization of such spinors. Our proof relies on the theory of spinorial forms, which we use to explicitly integrate the coupled flow for the spinor and underlying metric via a rotated pull-back action of the flow generated by a vector field on the Cauchy hypersurface $\Sigma$. We characterize the corresponding constraint equations as an explicit exterior differential system and describe all its solutions in terms of contact structures and flat foliations, obtaining a complete classification in the compact case. In particular, we conclude that every oriented compact three-manifold arises as the Cauchy hypersurface of a globally hyperbolic Lorentzian four-manifold equipped with a skew-torsion parallel spinor. Building on these results, we study the interaction between the four-dimensional Neveu-Schwarz supergravity evolution flow on an abelian bundle gerbe and the spinorial evolution flow determined by its supersymmetric conditions, which we prove to be well-posed and compatible. This establishes the well-posedness of the supersymmetric Neveu-Schwarz system in four dimensions and provides an initial-data characterization of supersymmetry. Furthermore, we obtain a strong rigidity result stating that every globally hyperbolic supersymmetric Neveu-Schwarz solution with a compact Cauchy hypersurface is flat and has vanishing bundle-gerbe curvature.

In the large-$N$, large-$q$ limit, the model reproduces the leading saddle-point structure of complex fermionic SYK under the identification of chemical potential with magnetic field and charge density with magnetization. We investigate the finite-$N$, finite-$q$ regime using exact diagonalization. A U(1)-invariant ordering susceptibility increases with system size for $q = 2, 4$ but decreases for $q = 6$, while bulk-spectrum level statistics are consistent with the Gaussian orthogonal ensemble at half filling and the Gaussian unitary ensemble in the adjacent magnetization sector. We further construct coupled-cluster chains and obtain domain-wall dynamics consistent with diffusive magnetization transport in a small-cluster regime accessible to matrix-product-state simulations. These results establish analytical benchmarks and finite-size signatures of ordering, quantum chaos, and magnetization transport in U(1)-symmetric spin-SYK models, and they motivate quantum simulation of the low-temperature, large-system regime, which remains difficult for classical methods.

English: We investigate an alternative ultraviolet (UV) structure for Renormalization Group improved (RG) black holes within a phenomenological framework inspired by asymptotically safe gravity. This prescription yields a Bessel type running Newton coupling with $G_I(r)\sim r$ in the UV, rather than the usual $G(r)\sim r^3$ behavior, and supports an integrable central singularity. The inner branch is matched through the Israel Darmois conditions to an exterior RG solution with $G_{II}\to G_0$ in the infrared, where $G_0$ is the Newton constant. Within the numerical range investigated, the resulting geometry has a single event horizon and no additional inner horizon. Since $\rho_{\rm NFW}\sim r^{-1}$ while $G_I(r)\sim r$ near the origin, the effective matter contribution entering the field equations remains finite, producing a cored effective behavior without modifying the NFW profile by hand. The gravitational decoupling algorithm keeps the quantum gravitational and dark matter sectors separately conserved within the same geometry. For the configurations considered, the NFW sector shifts the event horizon while preserving the single horizon structure. Thus, the same running coupling governs both the integrable UV black hole geometry and the softening of the central gravitational response of the NFW source.

Their nonzero finite corners are nonhyperfinite type $\mathrm{II}_1$ factors. 中文摘要：我们介绍 FOORT（Flexible Object-Oriented Ray Tracing），一个用于在任意时空中对黑洞及其他致密天体进行光线追踪成像的开源 C++ 代码。FOORT 以灵活性为设计目标，可处理视界、裸奇点和数值度规，因而能对包括 Kerr 及其他黑洞，以及 fuzzball、boson star 等无视界天体在内的众多不同度规进行光线追踪。新增解析或数值度规所需工作量很小；测地线从相机处初始化而不依赖守恒量，因此不需要度规具有特殊结构。除了几何薄且光学薄赤道盘所观测到的强度外，FOORT 还能沿每条测地线追踪多种诊断量，例如赤道穿越次数和最近接近半径。其自适应网格可依据这些诊断量对图像进行细化，从而高效分辨高阶光子环等窄特征。配套 Python 工具可将输出转换为图像和干涉可见度振幅。我们描述代码的主要功能，用 Schwarzschild 和 Kerr 时空的解析结果进行验证，在若干非 Kerr 度规上作演示，并刻画其随 OpenMP 线程数的扩展性。FOORT 轻量，仅需 C++17 和 OpenMP，并已被用于多项黑洞与致密天体成像研究。代码已在 GitHub 仓库公开。

English: We present FOORT (Flexible Object-Oriented Ray Tracing), an open C++ code for ray-tracing images of black holes and other compact objects in arbitrary spacetimes. FOORT is designed to offer flexibility and can handle horizons, naked singularities and numerical metrics, allowing it to ray-trace numerous different metrics including Kerr and other black holes, as well as horizonless objects such as fuzzballs and boson stars. New metrics, analytical or numerical, can be added with minimal effort, and geodesics are initialized at the camera without reference to conserved quantities, so no special structure of the metric is required. Besides the intensity observed from a geometrically and optically thin equatorial disk, FOORT is set up to track a number of diagnostics along each geodesic, such as the number of equatorial crossings and the radius of closest approach. Its adaptive mesh can refine the image on any of these diagnostics, efficiently resolving narrow features such as higher-order photon rings. Accompanying Python tools convert the output into images and interferometric visibility amplitudes. We describe the main features of the code, validate it against analytic results in the Schwarzschild and Kerr spacetimes, demonstrate it on several non-Kerr metrics, and characterize its scaling with the number of OpenMP threads. FOORT is lightweight, requiring only C++17 and OpenMP, and has already been used in a number of studies of black hole and compact-object imaging. The code is publicly available in a GitHub repository.

Giorgos Anastasiou · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：本文基于保持场方程渐近成立的无穷小体 Weyl 变换，为偶数维 Einstein-AdS 引力发展了一种基于对称性的重整化方法。通过要求 Einstein-Hilbert 密度的体协变完备项在参数为 Σ(X) 的限制 Weyl 变换下，其变分在径向截断移除后仅余有限项积分时消失，诱导出两类耦合固定的补偿项：Euler 密度和一列协变全导数。所得递推关系可用平移 Laplacian 的因子化解表示，从而给出任意偶数体维数下的闭式完备项。在 Einstein 背景上，匹配归一化后，这些表达式与通过共形不变量的 ambient 构造所得结果一致。相关的重整化体积恒等式确立了任意偶数维欧几里得 AlAdS Einstein 几何在 on-shell 下的有限性。该方案重现了四维、六维和八维已知的共形重整化作用量，并给出一个显式的十维完备项，其中包含最高至 □^3 的 Laplacian 幂次。对具有非共形平坦 Einstein 视界的八维和十维 AdS 黑洞的应用给出有限 on-shell 作用量，并与全息重整化结果一致。

English: We develop a symmetry-based approach to renormalization for even-dimensional Einstein-AdS gravity based on infinitesimal bulk Weyl transformations that preserve its field equations asymptotically. We determine a bulk-covariant completion of the Einstein-Hilbert density by requiring its variation under restricted Weyl transformations with parameter $\Sigma(X)$ to vanish modulo terms whose integrals remain finite as the radial cutoff is removed. This requirement induces two types of compensating terms with fixed couplings: the Euler density and a hierarchy of covariant total derivatives. The resulting recursive relations admit a factorized solution in terms of shifted Laplacians, yielding a closed-form completion in arbitrary even bulk dimensions. On Einstein backgrounds, these expressions agree, after matching normalizations, with those obtained through the ambient construction of conformal invariants. The associated renormalized-volume identity establishes on-shell finiteness for Euclidean AlAdS Einstein geometries in arbitrary even dimensions. The prescription reproduces the known conformally renormalized actions in four, six and eight dimensions and provides an explicit ten-dimensional completion involving powers of the Laplacian up to $\Box^3$. Applications to eight- and ten-dimensional AdS black holes with non-conformally-flat Einstein horizons yield finite on-shell actions in agreement with Holographic Renormalization.

一句话导读：基于限制体 Weyl 对称性构造任意偶数维 Einstein-AdS 引力的全息抵消项，并验证 AdS 黑洞的有限 on-shell 作用量。

相关度：medium — 论文研究 AdS/CFT 全息重整化与抵消项构造，并涉及经典 Einstein-AdS 引力及 AdS 黑洞 on-shell 作用量；与全息字典和经典引力支线相关，但不直接涉及所列超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子或探针膜等具体重点方向。

AdS 中 Yang-Mills 理论的全息 Wilsonian 重整化群

Holographic Wilsonian RG of Yang-Mills theory in AdS

Soner Albayrak · hep-th, cond-mat.stat-mech, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：本文将随机量子化与 Wilsonian 重整化之间的平衡-演化对偶推广到反 de Sitter 空间中的非阿贝尔规范理论，其中 AdS 的径向坐标扮演随机时间。对于没有显式径向依赖的体理论，我们证明在任意场阶数下，时刻 t 的 Langevin 分布是截断 ε=t 处紫外与红外径向波函数的乘积；因此将该 Langevin 过程识别为径向演化的基态（Doob）变换。通过显式计算，我们扩展了随机-重整化对偶中已有的字典：体场的径向分量是 Zwanziger 随机规范固定函数；径向规范是 Parisi-Wu 量子化；体规范 A_z=α^{-1}∂_i A_i 是 Zwanziger 规范。我们还以闭式给出有限截断下全息 Wilsonian 作用的三迹和四迹耦合表达式；在红外它们约化为已知胶子关联函数，并在总能量极点处如预期约化为平直空间 Yang-Mills 振幅。尽管显式结果是在树级并基于 AdS_4 得到，我们也评论了这些陈述的 de Sitter 对应以及圈修正。

English: In this work, we extend the equilibrium-evolution duality between stochastic quantization and Wilsonian renormalization to non-abelian gauge theories in anti-de Sitter space, for which the radial coordinate of AdS plays the role of the stochastic time. We show, to all orders in the fields for bulk theories without explicit radial dependence, that the Langevin distribution at time $t$ is the product of the ultraviolet and infrared radial wavefunctions at the cutoff $\epsilon=t$. We therefore identify this Langevin process as the ground-state (Doob) transform of the radial evolution. By explicit calculation, we also extend the existing dictionary in the stochastic-renormalization duality: the radial component of the bulk field is Zwanziger's stochastic gauge-fixing function; radial gauge is Parisi-Wu quantization; and the bulk gauge $A_z=\alpha^{-1}\partial_iA_i$ is Zwanziger's gauge. We also obtain the expressions for the triple-trace and quadruple-trace couplings of the holographic Wilsonian action at finite cutoff in closed form; in the infrared, they reduce to the known gluon correlators and, at the total-energy pole, to flat-space Yang-Mills amplitudes as expected. Although our explicit results are provided at tree-level and derived in AdS$_4$, we also comment on the de Sitter counterpart of these statements and on the loop corrections.

一句话导读：把随机量子化-Wilsonian RG 对偶推广到 AdS 非阿贝尔规范理论，并给出全息 Wilsonian 作用三/四迹耦合的闭式结果。

用四点关联函数成像双侧黑洞内部

Imaging the two-sided black hole interior with four-point correlators

Joydeep Chakravarty · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：我们提出一种用波包涂抹的边界四点函数，用于探测双侧 AdS 黑洞视界后的局域物理。在高频下，瞄准内部体点的边界波包沿测地线传播，并在该体点附近发生局域散射，使关联函数因子化为类平时空的散射振幅。为获得该构型，我们采用非平凡算符时序，并使用一个跨越热圆移动一半的态依赖算符插入。该可观测量的一个有趣性质是它也能探测非平凡态的特征：当体点穿过视界后的零激波和物质壳时，它们表现为观测信号中的跳变，从而成像黑洞内部。

English: We propose a boundary four-point function smeared with wavepackets, which probes local physics behind the horizon of a two-sided AdS black hole. At high frequencies, boundary wavepackets aimed at an interior bulk point travel along geodesics and scatter locally about the bulk point, factorizing the correlator into a flat-space like scattering amplitude. To obtain this configuration, we utilize a non-trivial time ordering of operators, and also use one state-dependent operator insertion moved halfway across the thermal circle. An interesting property of this observable is that it also probes features of nontrivial states: null shocks and matter shells behind the horizon show up as jumps in the observed signal as the bulk point crosses them, thereby imaging the black hole interior.

一句话导读：提出用波包涂抹的边界四点函数，通过特殊时序与态依赖算符插入探测双侧 AdS 黑洞视界后的局域散射，并成像内部激波与物质壳。

QCD 体粘滞与剪切粘滞比中的磁斜率交叉

Magnetic-slope crossovers in the QCD bulk-to-shear viscosity ratio

Aalok Misra, Shivam S. Kushwah, Keshav Dasgupta, Charles Gale, Sangyong Jeon · hep-th, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：磁场如何改变夸克-胶子物质中的耗散，几乎无法从第一性原理直接约束，因为格点模拟不能直接访问实时输运。本文采用受 MQGP 启发的自上而下 M/弦论构造来描述类 QCD 热等离子体，并结合指定单模准粒子截断下的动能论恒等式以及与现有格点物态方程数据的相容性构造，提出一个对归一化不敏感的信号预言：纵向体粘滞与剪切粘滞之比 ζ_∥/η_∥ 随磁场的斜率会随温度发生两次符号反转——分别在退禁闭伪临界温度 T_0 之下和之上，即 T_1<T_0<T_2（较低的 T_1 反转依赖于文中给出的π介子气体速率不等式）。采用相appropriately的载流子（T_0 以上的夸克-胶子等离子体和 T_0 以下的手征π介子气体）的动能论恒等式可重现同样的图样，格点声速数据也可显示为相容。退禁闭相中的自下而上 VQCD 支持大温度下斜率为负；该斜率交叉无法从现有 ζ_∥/s、η_∥/s 图中分辨。

English: How a magnetic field alters dissipation in quark--gluon matter is almost unconstrained from first principles, since real-time transport is not directly accessible to lattice simulation. Using a top-down MQGP-inspired M/string-theory construction of a QCD-like thermal plasma, together with a kinetic-theory identity within a specified single-mode quasiparticle truncation and a compatibility construction using available lattice equation-of-state data, we propose a normalization-insensitive sign prediction that the field slope of the longitudinal bulk-to-shear viscosity ratio \zeta_\parallel/\eta_\parallel reverses sign twice with temperature---below and above the deconfinement pseudo-critical temperature T_0, at T_1<T_0<T_2 (the lower reversal T_1 conditional on a stated pion-gas rate inequality). A kinetic-theory identity with phase-appropriate carriers, a quark--gluon plasma above T_0 and a chiral pion gas below, reproduces the same pattern, and lattice speed-of-sound data can be shown to be consistent as well. The bottom-up VQCD in the deconfined phase supports a negative slope for large temperatures; the slope crossover is not resolvable from the available \zeta_\parallel/s, \eta_\parallel/s plots.

一句话导读：利用 MQGP 启发式 M/弦论构造与动能论预言纵向体粘滞-剪切粘滞比随磁场的斜率在退禁闭伪临界温度两侧发生两次符号反转。

长程相互作用引力中的精确红外三角

Exact Infrared Triangle in Gravity with Long-Range Interactions

Sangmin Choi, Ameya Kadhe, Prahar Mitra, Andrea Puhm · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：与无质量物质耦合的 Einstein 引力在红外表现出普适性。我们证明，在存在长程相互作用时，一种新的超旋转荷守恒等价于经典对数软引力子定理的无质量极限，并提出位移记忆相应尾项的公式。这些结果以定性不同的方式推广了此前关于引力与有质量物质耦合的工作，在引力耦合下是精确的，并表明长程引力 dressing 会发生重求和。我们还计算了已知超旋转荷的高阶修正，这些修正在引力耦合下精确，并将对应于 Cachazo-Strominger 次领头软引力子定理的单圈精确修正。

English: Einstein gravity coupled to massless matter exhibits universality in the infrared. In the presence of long-range interactions we show that a novel superrotation charge conservation is equivalent to the massless limit of the classical logarithmic soft graviton theorem, and we propose a formula for the corresponding tail to the displacement memory. These results, which extend earlier work on gravity coupled to massive matter in a qualitatively different way, are exact in the gravitational coupling and reveal that long-range gravitational dressings resum. We also compute higher-order corrections to the known superrotation charge which are exact in the gravitational coupling and would correspond to a 1-loop exact correction to the Cachazo-Strominger subleading soft graviton theorem.

一句话导读：在长程相互作用下，超旋转荷守恒、对数软引力子定理与位移记忆尾项构成精确红外三角。

AdS/CFT 中的 Swing 曲面

Swing Surfaces in AdS/CFT

Jacqueline Caminiti, Sabrina Pasterski · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：我们研究 AdS3/CFT2 平直极限下的全息纠缠熵，并厘清 Ryu-Takayanagi 曲面与平直空间全息中提出的 swing 曲面之间的关系。我们表明通常的 RT 公式没有良定义的平直空间极限，并将其与平直极限下态-算符映射的微妙之处联系起来。随后我们构造 swing 方案的 AdS3 提升，并通过两种互补途径发展其信息论解释。第一，我们证明 swing 曲面长度计算一类特殊纯 CFT 态中适当选择的近零边界区间之间的互信息；该结果的引力解释涉及发生在 AdS3 体深处中的散射过程。第二，我们将寻找 swing 曲面信息论解释的问题化归为全息中黑洞内视界信息论解释的更一般问题。

English: We study holographic entanglement entropy in the flat limit of AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$, and clarify the relation between Ryu-Takayanagi surfaces and the swing surfaces proposed for flat-space holography. We show that the ordinary RT formula does not admit a well-defined flat-space limit and connect this to subtleties of the state-operator map in the flat limit. We then construct an AdS$_3$ uplift of the swing prescription and develop its corresponding information-theoretic interpretation through two complementary approaches. First, we show that the swing surface length computes the mutual information between suitably chosen nearly null boundary intervals in a special class of pure CFT states. The gravity interpretation of this result involves scattering processes which take place deep inside of the AdS$_3$ bulk. Second, we reduce the problem of finding an information-theoretic interpretation for swing surfaces to the more general problem of finding an information-theoretic interpretation of black hole inner horizons in holography.

一句话导读：该文澄清平直空间全息中 swing 曲面与 RT 曲面的关系，并给出其 AdS3 提升及基于互信息和黑洞内视界的信息论解释。

熵与电荷输运限制全息中的 Mpemba 制备

Entropy and charge transport limit Mpemba preparation in holography

Yu Shi, Sheng Long · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：我们研究具有完整背反应的全息超导体中的 Mpemba 弛豫及其制备成本。在最终能量和电荷匹配时，边界驱动可在撤源后逆转剩余视界熵的排序。在分开的数值比较中，一些方案即使计入驱动和等待时间也更早达到给定容差。为考察制备极限，我们考虑已携带慢标量场和外电荷的临界态。在固定能量和电荷的临界慢分支上，视界位移抵消二次面积响应，对初始标量幅度 ε 留下 O(ε^4) 的熵储备。同一系数将该储备与附近超导平衡的熵优势以及正常侧慢尾的熵权重联系起来。该有限储备限制已有场被移除的速度。对于抑制领头视界场和外电荷的释放，在视界正则性和均匀径向控制下，制备时间至少按 ε^{-2} 增长。电荷输运约束产生视界熵的同一协变标量流，提高最小流通量成本并强化时间界。

English: We study Mpemba relaxation and its preparation cost in a holographic superconductor with full backreaction. At matched final energy and charge, boundary drives can reverse the ordering of the remaining horizon entropy after source removal. In separate numerical comparisons, some protocols reach a given tolerance earlier even when driving and waiting times are included. To examine the limits of preparation, we consider critical states that already carry a slow scalar field and exterior charge. Along the critical slow branch at fixed energy and charge, horizon displacement cancels the quadratic area response, leaving an entropy reserve of $O(\varepsilon^4)$ for an initial scalar amplitude $\varepsilon$. The same coefficient connects this reserve to the entropy advantage of the nearby superconducting equilibrium and the entropy weight of the slow tail on the normal side. This limited reserve constrains how quickly the existing field can be removed. For releases that suppress the leading horizon field and exterior charge, the preparation time grows at least as $\varepsilon^{-2}$ under horizon regularity and uniform radial control. Charge transport constrains the same covariant scalar flux that produces horizon entropy, raising the minimum flux cost and strengthening the time bound.

一句话导读：全息超导体中，Mpemba 弛豫与制备受视界熵储备及电荷输运约束，制备时间至少按标量幅度平方反比增长。

AdS4×S7/Z_k 上 11 维超引力的 1 圈配分函数：匹配 ABJM 自由能中的 A(k)

1-loop partition function of 11d supergravity on $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$: matching $A(k)$ in ABJM free energy

Stefan A. Kurlyand, Arkady A. Tseytlin · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：ABJM 理论在 S^3 上自由能的大 N 展开中出现的函数 A(k) 已由局域化精确给出。此前基于 S^7 上标准 KK 谱对 AdS4×S7/Z_k 上 11 维超引力 1 圈配分函数的计算未能重现它。我们识别出一个缺失的 1 圈超引力贡献：由欧氏 AdS4 上平方可积调和 2-形式与 S^7 模式张量构造的 3-形式场涨落，这些涨落不被 KK 谱捕获。将其加入用超共形特征表示的 KK 塔贡献并施加 Z_k 投影后，总表达式简化，并在 zeta 函数方案下求值可重现 A(k) 的表达式。我们还将类似方法应用于 3d ADHM 理论，其 M 理论对偶为 orbifold AdS4×S7/Z_p，该 orbifold 沿固定轨迹 AdS4×S^3 具有奇异性，并支持一个 7d SU(p) 矢量多重态。将该多重态的局域化 KK 模式加入 Z_p 投影后的超引力谱，得到的 1 圈自由能重现了 A(k) 的 ADHM 局域化对应物。

English: The function $A(k)$ appearing in the large $N$ expansion of free energy of ABJM theory on $S^3$ is known exactly from localization. An earlier calculation of the 1-loop partition function of 11d supergravity on $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$, based on the standard KK spectrum on $S^7$, did not reproduce it. We identify a missing 1-loop supergravity contribution as that of the 3-form field fluctuations built from square-integrable harmonic 2-forms on Euclidean $\mathrm{AdS}_4$ tensored with $S^7$ modes, which are not captured by the KK spectrum. Adding it to the KK tower contribution expressed in terms of superconformal characters and applying the $\mathbb{Z}_k$ projection, the total expression simplifies, and its evaluation in a zeta-function prescription reproduces the expression for $A(k)$. We also apply a similar approach to the 3d ADHM theory whose M-theory dual is the orbifold $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_p$, which has singularity along the fixed locus $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^3$, supporting a 7d $SU(p)$ vector multiplet. Adding the localized KK modes of this multiplet to the $\mathbb{Z}_p$-projected supergravity spectrum gives a 1-loop free energy that reproduces the ADHM localization counterpart of $A(k)$.

一句话导读：补上 AdS4×S7/Z_k 上未被 KK 谱包含的 3-形式涨落，使 11 维超引力 1 圈配分函数重现 ABJM 局域化给出的 A(k)。

二维 Ising 模型的全息对偶

Holographic dual of the 2d Ising model

Kazumi Okuyama · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：我们提出二维环面上 Ising 模型的全息对偶，即实心环面上的 Turaev-Viro TQFT。体时空被分为“core”区域和“sandwich”区域。core 区域在拓扑边界 D 上制备一个缺陷态 |D>。sandwich 区域计算拓扑边界 D 上的态 |D> 与物理边界 B 上的态 |F> 之间的 Turaev-Viro 态求和 <D|Π|F>。物理边界 B 上的融合图（或 string-net）F 由 Aasen-Fendley-Mong 构造给出。D 与 B 之间还存在一个“bedding surface” S，高度变量（或畴壁内/外的 Ising 自旋）自然生活在 S 上。体时空由插值 D 与 F 的 2-skeleton P 离散化。当缺陷 D 不存在时，2-skeleton P 终止于 bedding surface S，并且 P 被解释为 string-net F 的体世界面。

English: We propose a holographic dual of the 2d Ising model on a torus as the Turaev-Viro TQFT on a solid torus. The bulk spacetime is divided into the ``core'' region and the ``sandwich'' region. The core region prepares a defect state $|\mathcal{D}\rangle$ on the topological boundary $\mathbb{D}$. The sandwich region computes the Turaev-Viro state sum $\langle\mathcal{D}|\Pi|\mathcal{F}\rangle$ between the state $|\mathcal{D}\rangle$ on $\mathbb{D}$ and the state $|\mathcal{F}\rangle$ on the physical boundary $\mathbb{B}$. The fusion diagram (or string-net) $\mathcal{F}$ on $\mathbb{B}$ is given by the Aasen-Fendley-Mong construction. There is also a ``bedding surface'' $\mathbb{S}$ between $\mathbb{D}$ and $\mathbb{B}$, and the height variables (or Ising spins inside/outside of the domain wall) are naturally living on $\mathbb{S}$. The bulk spacetime is discretized by the 2-skeleton $P$ which interpolates $\mathcal{D}$ and $\mathcal{F}$. When the defect $\mathcal{D}$ is absent, the 2-skeleton $P$ ends on the bedding surface $\mathbb{S}$ and $P$ is interpreted as the bulk worldsheet of the string-net $\mathcal{F}$.

一句话导读：提出二维环面 Ising 模型的全息对偶为实心环面上的 Turaev-Viro TQFT，并用 core/sandwich 区域、string-net 与 bedding surface 描述体时空。

中文摘要：我们研究将Weyl张量平方、Ricci张量平方和Ricci标量平方不变量及其Gauss-Bonnet组合扩展到离壳五维N=2规范超引力后的谱与中心荷。精确到耦合常数并保留所有辅助场，我们将最大超对称AdS5真空附近的谱组织成超多重态。Ricci标量平方不变量使谱获得一个长矢量多重态，并在有限耦合范围内无鬼；Weyl平方或Ricci张量平方不变量则获得长自旋2多重态且总含鬼或不稳定。Gauss-Bonnet组合不添加新模：在其超对称真空附近，二次作用量是二导数理论的重标度拷贝，并固定Ricci张量平方扩展的谱。我们还在耦合中精确计算中心荷a、c和味中心荷。真空方程是a最大化；无质量引力子和矢量多重态的动能项分别正比于c和味中心荷，因此临界点（大质量自旋2多重态与引力子多重态简并）是c的零点。最后，在Gauss-Bonnet扩展的超对称AdS3×Σ2背景附近，二维中心荷由c极值化重现，而谱一般非酉并包含在大的Kaluza-Klein能级上能量有界的态塔。在部分参数空间，自旋2多重态塔具有正模，因此谱没有有限态密度。

English: We study the spectra and the central charges of off-shell gauged five-dimensional $\mathcal N=2$ supergravity extended by the Weyl squared, Ricci tensor squared and Ricci scalar squared invariants, and by their Gauss-Bonnet combination. Working exactly in the couplings and keeping all auxiliary fields, we organize the spectra around the maximally supersymmetric AdS$_5$ vacuum into supermultiplets. With the Ricci scalar squared invariant, the spectrum gains a long vector multiplet and is free of ghosts in a finite range of the coupling, while with the Weyl squared or Ricci tensor squared invariant, it gains a long spin-2 multiplet and always contains ghosts or instabilities. The Gauss-Bonnet combination adds no new modes: around its supersymmetric vacuum, the quadratic action is a rescaled copy of that of the two-derivative theory, and this fixes the spectrum of the Ricci tensor squared extension. We also compute the central charges $a$ and $c$ and the flavor central charge exactly in the couplings. The vacuum equation is $a$-maximization, and the kinetic terms of the massless graviton and vector multiplets are proportional to $c$ and to the flavor central charge, so that the critical points, where the massive spin-2 multiplet becomes degenerate with the graviton multiplet, are zeros of $c$. Finally, around supersymmetric AdS$_3\times\Sigma_2$ backgrounds of the Gauss-Bonnet extension, the two-dimensional central charges are reproduced by $c$-extremization, while the spectrum is generically not unitary and contains towers of states whose energies stay bounded at large Kaluza-Klein levels. In part of the parameter space, the tower of spin-2 multiplets has positive norm, so that the spectrum has no finite density of states.

English: In this paper, we construct new self-gravitating solutions for the four-dimensional $SU(2)$ Einstein non-linear sigma model and the Einstein-Skyrme model, both minimally coupled to the Maxwell field, which describes spinning pulsed mesonic tubes. These solutions are gyratonic in the sense that they are characterized by a propagation axis and possess angular momentum. The gyratonic solutions are described by a smooth matter distribution, which is free of curvature singularities. The maximum of the energy density is concentrated on a tube around the propagation axis. We first consider the $SU(2)$ non-linear sigma model minimally coupled to General Relativity and the Maxwell field, constructing asymptotically flat, spinning, pulsed gyratonic solutions. Subsequently, we include the Skyrme term in the analysis. In this case, we show that in order to maintain the resolvability of the matter field equations, the spacetime must be asymptotically de Sitter. It is also shown that, despite the fact that the total topological charge is zero, these solutions possess a non-zero topological charge density.

从零测地线旅行时间看共形边界刚性

Conformal boundary rigidity from null geodesic travel times

Gabriel Paternain, Eric Woolgar · math.DG, gr-qc · v4 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：一个遥远、孤立系统的引力场由共形不变的Weyl张量体现。因此，远离系统的共形结构编码了系统的引力质量。它也编码了因果结构，从而将其与质量联系起来。对于渐近反德西特（AdS）时空，这种联系导致了Page、Surya和第二作者提出的新颖正质量定理，该定理不依赖于任何传统能量条件。这里我们问该定理是否有刚性情况。具体来说，我们考虑渐近AdS时空中所有从Penrose共形无穷远出发、穿过时空并返回共形无穷远的零测地线。如果从给定点出发的所有此类测地线都在无穷远的对跖点重新聚焦，那么时空是否共形于反德西特空间？如果渐近AdS时空（i）在3或4维时空中满足零能量条件，或（ii）是静态的（任意维度），则问题很容易回答，我们在这些情况下给出简单证明。然后，我们通过应用在由平稳Killing向量场商得到的带边界黎曼流形上的磁测地线理论，回答了全局平稳渐近AdS时空中的问题。该问题在渐近平坦时空中也有类似，我们也进行了讨论。

English: The gravitational field of a distant, isolated system is manifested by the conformally invariant Weyl tensor. Thus the conformal structure far from the system encodes the system's gravitational mass. It also encodes the causal structure, thereby linking it to the mass. For asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetimes, this link led to a novel positive mass theorem of Page, Surya, and the second author \cite{PSW} which did not rely on any traditional energy condition. Here we ask whether that theorem has a rigidity case. Specifically, we consider all null geodesics in an asymptotically AdS spacetime that depart from the Penrose conformal infinity, travel through spacetime, and return to conformal infinity. If all such geodesics from a given point refocus at an antipodal point at infinity, is the spacetime conformal to anti-de Sitter space? It is easy to answer the question if the asymptotically AdS spacetime either (i) obeys the null energy condition in 3 or 4 spacetime dimensions, or (ii) is static (in any dimension), and we give simple proofs in those cases. We then answer the question in the case of globally stationary, asymptotically AdS spacetimes, by applying the theory of magnetic geodesics on the Riemannian manifold-with-boundary obtained by quotienting by the stationary Killing vector field. The question has an analogue for asymptotically flat spacetimes, which we also discuss.

一句话导读：研究渐近AdS时空中零测地线重新聚焦是否意味着时空共形于AdS，并给出多种情况下的证明。

English: Quasi-Periodic Eruptions (QPEs) display correlated long/short and strong/weak patterns that remain unexplained by existing flat-disk collision models. We propose that these features arise from an extreme-mass-ratio inspiral (EMRI) colliding with a warped accretion disk, likely formed after a tidal disruption event. The warp modulates both recurrence time and burst energy, encoding the disk geometry -- and thus the spin of the central supermassive black hole (SMBH) -- into the X-ray light curve. We introduce the Brightness-Recurrence Diagram (BRD) to visualize this correlation, where QPE bursts trace an elliptical trajectory driven by the EMRI's apsidal precession; the tilt of this ellipse encodes whether the EMRI is prograde or retrograde relative to the SMBH spin. Applying this model to the prototypical QPE source GSN 069 successfully reproduces the observed patterns. The data are consistent with either a prograde stellar secondary or a retrograde stellar-mass black hole. In the stellar-mass black hole scenario, ongoing orbital decay could render the EMRI detectable by LISA within a few decades, facilitating gravitational-wave follow-up and independent multimessenger constraints on the system.

跨时空维度与引力理论的光环稳定性

Light Ring Stability Across Spacetime Dimensions and Theories of Gravity

Kajol Paithankar, Sanved Kolekar · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：光环定理指出，在四维广义相对论中，若零能量条件（NEC）成立，四维稳态、轴对称、无视界的超紧凑天体（UCOs）会成对拥有光环（LRs），其中一个是稳定的。稳定LR的存在可能触发非线性时空不稳定性，从而对UCOs作为长寿命黑洞模仿者的可行性提出疑问。我们将LR存在性与稳定性定理从四维GR推广到修改引力理论，特别是f(R)引力、标量-张量理论、受限Horndeski引力和Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet（EGB）引力，并在d≥4维时空中讨论。结果表明，在四维修改引力中，LR的稳定性除NEC外还受理论特定耦合参数支配；因此，在某些参数区域不保证出现稳定LR。在高维（d>4）情形下，我们通过拓扑论证确认LR仍成对出现；然而，拓扑荷现在与四类不同的LR相关，其中包括两类鞍点。稳定性分析进一步限制了允许的LR配对，这意味着与四维GR不同，出现的LR配对不一定包含稳定LR。我们的结果直接影响使用UCOs检验GR，表明LR稳定性对底层引力理论与时空维度高度敏感。

English: The light ring theorem states that four-dimensional stationary, axisymmetric, horizonless ultracompact objects (UCOs) possess light rings (LRs) in pairs, one of which is stable if the Null Energy Condition (NEC) holds in General Relativity (GR). The existence of a stable LR may trigger nonlinear spacetime instabilities, thereby raising questions about the viability of UCOs as long-lived black hole mimickers. We extend the LR existence and stability theorem beyond four-dimensional GR to modified gravity theories, in particular, $f(R)$ gravity, scalar-tensor theories, restricted Horndeski gravity and Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet (EGB) gravity, in ($d \geq 4$) dimensional spacetimes. Our findings show that in four-dimensional modified gravities, the stability of LRs is governed by theory-specific coupling parameters in addition to the NEC. Consequently, a stable LR is not guaranteed to occur in certain parameter regimes. In higher dimensions ($d>4$), we confirm using topological arguments that LRs still emerge in pairs; however, the topological charges are now associated with four distinct types of LRs, including two types of saddle points. The stability analysis further constrains the allowed LR pairings, implying that, unlike in four-dimensional GR, the emergent pair does not necessarily include a stable LR. Our findings directly impact tests of GR using UCOs, demonstrating that LR stability is highly sensitive to both the underlying gravitational theory and spacetime dimensionality.

一句话导读：将光环存在性与稳定性定理推广到高维修改引力，发现稳定光环并非必然出现，从而影响UCOs作为黑洞模仿者及GR检验。

用GW250114约束对Teukolsky方程的偏离

Constraining deviations from the Teukolsky equation with GW250114

Sebastian H. V\"olkel, Nicola Franchini · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：利用LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA合作组对GW250114的观测，首次给出对Teukolsky方程理论无关偏离的约束。beyond-Teukolsky形式将Teukolsky方程有效势层面的扰动偏离与准正模（QNM）谱变化直接联系。分析中把完整inspiral-merger-ringdown分析得到的最终质量和自旋信息作为参数化先验，并使用公开的agnostic damped sinusoid后验参数，展示可约束的beyond-Teukolsky势范围。高信噪比允许避免对全部参数进行昂贵的完整贝叶斯分析，而直接采用仅含基频QNM的简化似然。当前对偏离参数的约束与Teukolsky方程一致。

English: The recent gravitational-wave detection GW250114 by the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) Collaboration provides unprecedented precision for testing general relativity (GR) through black hole ringdowns. In this study, we provide the first bounds on theory-agnostic deviations from the Teukolsky equation as described by the beyond-Teukolsky formalism. It directly connects deviations in the perturbation equations on the level of the effective potential in the Teukolsky equation with changes in the quasinormal mode (QNM) spectrum. We incorporate information on the final mass and spin from a full LVK inspiral-merger-ringdown analysis as parametrized priors in our analysis, reflecting theoretical uncertainties. Using publicly available LVK posterior information on agnostic damped sinusoid parameters, we then demonstrate how much beyond-Teukolsky potentials can be constrained. The high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) allows us to avoid the expensive full Bayesian analysis of all parameters and to work directly with a simplified likelihood for the fundamental QNM only. This strategy is promising for future events with even higher SNR and allows, in principle, for a quick and simple test of theories beyond GR without performing the full data analysis procedure. We report that current bounds on deviation parameters are in agreement with the Teukolsky equation.

一句话导读：利用GW250114高信噪比ringdown数据，首次对beyond-Teukolsky有效势偏离给出理论无关约束，结果与Teukolsky方程一致。

相关度：medium — 论文直接研究经典引力、黑洞ringdown与QNM，并给出对广义相对论/Teukolsky方程的观测约束，与“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM”重点标签相关；但不涉及全息/AdS-CFT研究。

f(R,K)引力中的静态黑洞与Iyer-Wald熵

Static Black Holes and Iyer-Wald Entropy in $f(\mathcal{R},\mathcal{K})$ Gravity

I. D\'iaz-Salda\~na, J. L\'opez-Dom\'inguez, Wilfredo Yupanqui, Javier Chagoya, M. Sabido · gr-qc · v4 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：我们研究一类由拉格朗日量 f=-X^{1-n} 描述的非多项式引力理论中的静态球对称黑洞解，其中 X = R + sqrt(6K - R^2) 是 Ricci 标量 R 与 Kretschmann 标量 K 的函数。修改后的 Einstein 方程包含非多项式曲率项。我们发展一种微扰方案来寻找参数上偏离 Schwarzschild 几何的黑洞解。通过求解相应的耦合微分方程，我们得到度规的一阶修正。随后在微扰耦合的一阶一致地计算相应的 Iyer-Wald 熵。我们表明非多项式贡献导致 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵的幂律修正。

English: We investigate static, spherically symmetric black hole solutions in a class of {nonpolynomial} gravitational theories described by a {Lagrangian $f=-X^{1-n}$, where $X = \mathcal{R} + \sqrt{6\mathcal{K} - \mathcal{R}^2}$ is a function of the Ricci and Kretschmann scalars.} The modified Einstein equations contain {nonpolynomial} curvature terms. We develop a perturbative scheme to look for a black hole solution that deviates parametrically from the Schwarzschild geometry. We obtain first-order corrections to the metric by solving the resulting coupled differential equations. The corresponding Iyer--Wald entropy is then evaluated consistently to first order in the perturbative coupling. We show that the {nonpolynomial} contribution gives rise to a power-law correction to the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy.

一句话导读：在 f(R,K) 非多项式引力中微扰构造偏离 Schwarzschild 的静态黑洞，并计算 Iyer-Wald 熵的幂律修正。

de Sitter 广义相对论的一阶规范方法

A First-Order Gauge Approach to de Sitter General Relativity

P. Salgado · gr-qc · v5 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：本文提出 de Sitter 相对论的一阶规范表述，其中伪半径 l(x) 被提升为时空场，并使 SO(4,1) 局域破缺到 SO(3,1)。l(x) 是几何补偿子，dl(x) 是对应序参量。该框架修改强等效原理：局域真空跟随物质分布而非保持固定，但广义相对论的传播自由度不变。在固定 l(x) 时作用量具有 SO(3,1) 规范不变性，而变分 l(x) 会破坏 SO(4,1) 完整平移部分的协变性。通过 Inonu-Wigner 收缩，抽象生成元成为显式时空变换，并在宏观 l→∞ 与微观 l→0 极限给出非线性 Killing 矢量。推广的 Noether 定理给出统一能量-动量流，将标准张量与恰当共形物质流耦合；无物质时该流恒为零，导致局域真空能渐近消失、背景衰减到 Minkowski 时空。独立变分得到耦合的 de Sitter 场方程，并代数证明其与坐标流形上的张量分解等价。规范 Bianchi 恒等式进一步表明 Λ(x) 是时空挠率的內禀源，并一致地将其等同于对称破缺的局域序参量。因此宇宙学常数问题被重新表述而非数值解决：从早期宇宙密度推导 Λ(x) 衰减到观测值仍是未来工作。

English: We propose a first-order gauge formulation of de Sitter relativity in which the pseudo-radius l(x) is promoted to a spacetime field, locally breaking SO(4,1) to SO(3,1). Here, l(x) is a geometric compensator and dl(x) the associated order parameter. This modifies the Strong Equivalence Principle: the local vacuum follows the matter distribution instead of remaining fixed, while the propagating degrees of freedom of General Relativity are unchanged. At fixed l(x), the action is SO(3,1)-gauge invariant, but varying l(x) destroys covariance under the full translational sector of SO(4,1). Through the Inonu-Wigner contraction, abstract generators become explicit spacetime transformations, yielding nonlinear Killing vectors in both the macroscopic l tends to infinity and microscopic l tends to 0 limits. The generalized Noether theorem gives a unified energy-momentum current coupling the standard tensor to the proper conformal matter current. It vanishes identically without matter, causing the asymptotic extinction of local vacuum energy and the decay of the background to Minkowski spacetime. Independent variations yield the coupled de Sitter field equations, and we algebraically prove their equivalence to the tensorial splitting on the coordinate manifold. Gauge Bianchi identities further show that Lambda(x) is an intrinsic source of spacetime torsion, consistently identifying it with the local order parameter of the symmetry breaking. The cosmological constant problem is therefore recast, not numerically solved: deriving the decay of Lambda(x) from early-universe densities to its observed value remains future work.

一句话导读：提出把 de Sitter 伪半径提升为时空场的一阶规范表述，证明其场方程与张量分解等价，并将宇宙学常数问题重述为 Λ(x) 的动力学衰减问题而非数值解决。

相关度：high — 论文主要研究 de Sitter 广义相对论的一阶规范表述与经典场方程，直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

旋转 Konoplya-Zhidenko 黑洞在厚吸积流下的视界尺度强度与偏振图像

Horizon-scale intensity and polarization images of rotating Konoplya-Zhidenko black holes with thick accretion flows

Bing-Bing Chen, Chen-Yu Yang, Guo-Ping Li, Xin-Yun Hu · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v3 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：本文研究被几何厚、光学薄吸积流包围的 Konoplya-Zhidenko 旋转非 Kerr 黑洞的阴影与偏振图像。吸积流采用解析弹道近似模型。数值结果表明，阴影图像具有外亮环和内暗区两个主要特征：外亮环对应高阶像，内暗区对应光子被黑洞捕获。增大形变参数 η 不会显著改变高阶像的整体形状，但会增大其尺寸；增大自旋参数 a 或观测倾角 θ_o 会增强高阶像的不对称性，并使左侧强度远大于右侧，这与参考系拖曳和相对论多普勒效应有关。在偏振图像中，高阶像区域的线偏振度明显低于其他区域，且偏振矢量覆盖整个像平面。论文说明时空几何与近视界吸积动力学如何共同影响强度与偏振图像。

English: We investigate the shadow and polarization images of a Konoplya--Zhidenko rotating non-Kerr black hole surrounded by a geometrically thick and optically thin accretion flow. The accretion flow is described by an analytical ballistic approximation accretion flow model. The numerical results show that the shadow image exhibits two main features, an outer bright ring and an inner dark region. The former corresponds to higher-order images, while the latter is associated with photon capture by the black hole. Increasing the deformation parameter $\eta$ does not significantly change the overall shape of the higher-order images, but it enlarges their size. Increasing either the spin parameter $a$ or the observer inclination angle $\theta_o$ enhances the asymmetry of the higher-order images and makes the intensity on the left side much larger than that on the right side. This behavior is associated with frame dragging and the relativistic Doppler effect. In the polarization images, the degree of linear polarization is much smaller in the higher-order image region than in other regions, and the polarization vectors extend over the whole image plane. Within the framework used in this work, these results illustrate how the spacetime geometry and near-horizon accretion dynamics jointly influence the intensity and polarization images.

一句话导读：用厚吸积流模型计算旋转 Konoplya-Zhidenko 非 Kerr 黑洞的阴影强度与偏振图像，并分析形变、自旋和倾角对高阶像的影响。

SPLIT：面向长旋进引力波源的弱相干推断，以增强对建模误差和数据异常值的鲁棒性

SPLIT: Loosely-coherent inference of long-inspiral gravitational-wave sources for robustness against modeling and data outliers

Shubham Kejriwal · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM · v4 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：LISA 将探测数十个极端/中等质量比旋进（EMRI/IMRI）引力波源，这些源可在带内持续数月至数年。传统全相位相干分析对波形精度要求极高，长时标建模失败会导致显著系统偏差。本文提出一种稳健贝叶斯推断框架：将数据分段，对每段进行相干推断，并用弱相干相位信息重组结果；通过把完整相位跟踪限制在更短的块时长内，避免相位误差大量累积。作者在 GPU 加速的 Python 包 SPLIT 中实现该方法，并用于一个环境丰富的注入案例：全相干真空-GR 分析相对真值的最大一维系统偏差约为 4.8σ，而弱相干方法将偏差限制在约 0.5σ 以内。尽管最优信噪比有少量损失，参数精度的显著改善对 LISA 和未来引力波探测器是有利的权衡。

English: The Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) will detect gravitational waves (GWs) from dozens of extreme- and intermediate-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs/IMRIs). These sources will stay in-band for months to years, offering extraordinary scientific potential. However, their fully phase-coherent analysis standard in current pipelines imposes stringent waveform accuracy requirements; failing to model the signal over such long durations can result in significant systematic biases. To address this, we formulate a robust Bayesian inference framework that segments the data into blocks, infers each block coherently, and recombines the results using loosely-coherent phase information. By restricting full phase-tracking to much shorter block durations, this approach prevents significant accumulation of phase errors. We implement this methodology in \textsc{SPLIT} (Segmented Posteriors for Long-Inspiral Templates), a GPU-accelerated Python package. Applying \textsc{SPLIT} to an environment-rich injection, we demonstrate that while a fully-coherent vacuum-GR analysis incurs a maximum 1D systematic bias of $\approx 4.8\sigma$ from the truth, the shorter integration window of our loosely-coherent approach restricts such biases to $\lesssim 0.5\sigma$. Overall, despite a fractional loss of optimal signal-to-noise ratio, the substantial improvement in parameter accuracy offered by our method presents a highly advantageous trade-off for LISA and other future GW detectors.

一句话导读：提出分段弱相干贝叶斯推断框架 SPLIT，降低 LISA 长旋进引力波源对波形建模误差和数据异常值的系统偏差。

一般各向异性物质环境中黑洞的准正规模与潮汐响应

Quasinormal modes and tidal responses of black holes in generic anisotropic matter environments

Yu-Qian Zhao (Dipartimento di Fisica, Sapienza Universit\`a di Roma, INFN, Sezione di Roma), Paolo Pani (Dipartimento di Fisica, Sapienza Universit\`a di Roma, INFN, Sezione di Roma) · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v3 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：我们为嵌入球对称、可能各向异性的一般物质环境中的黑洞建立了一个微扰框架。该方法扩展了此前仅限于零径向压力或微扰物质位形的分析。在此框架内，我们推导了包含多方径向压力的 Einstein cluster 的解析推广，并研究了该解的性质。我们表明，测地线结构和轴向准正规模谱仍主要受整体引力红移效应支配，而径向压力会系统性增强环境修正。相比之下，潮汐 Love 数敏感得多，并可能出现量级为一的偏离，包括在足够大各向异性下严格静态磁 Love 数消失甚至为负。我们给出了完整的线性化方程，可应用于包括 ringdown 分析和极端质量比旋近在内的多种扩展。

English: We develop a perturbative framework for a black hole embedded in a generic, possibly anisotropic, matter environment under spherical symmetry. Our approach extends previous analyses restricted to vanishing radial pressure or to perturbative matter configurations. Within this framework, we derive an analytical generalization of the Einstein cluster that incorporates a polytropic radial pressure, and we investigate the properties of this solution. We show that both the geodesic structure and the axial quasinormal-mode spectrum remain predominantly governed by an overall gravitational redshift effect, while the radial pressure systematically enhances the environmental corrections. In contrast, the tidal Love numbers are substantially more sensitive, and can exhibit order-unity deviations, including vanishing and negative strictly static magnetic Love numbers for sufficiently large anisotropy. We present the full linearized equations, which can be applied to various extensions, including ringdown analysis and extreme-mass-ratio inspirals.

一句话导读：建立一般各向异性球对称物质环境中的黑洞微扰框架，发现 QNM 主要受引力红移控制而潮汐 Love 数对各向异性高度敏感。

坠入深渊前的自旋尾旋：Kerr时空中近赤道坠落自旋粒子的解析解

Going into a tailspin near the abyss: analytic solutions for spinning particles on near equatorial, plunging orbits in Kerr spacetime

Gabriel Andres Piovano · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-11-13

中文摘要：本工作首次给出Kerr时空中自旋测试粒子在近赤道、坠落运动中的解析解。作者在粒子自旋一阶近似下求解了所有能量 E<1 的坠落轨道类别，并纳入由粒子自旋进动引起的轨道面小进动。文中还给出了最内束缚圆轨道半径修正的闭式表达，并为一般坠落轨道引入一种新的类开普勒参数化。这些解将有助于使用自力方法和黑洞微扰论对旋进-并合-铃宕波形进行建模。

English: This work presents, the first time, analytic solutions for the nearly equatorial, plunging motion of a spinning test-particle in Kerr spacetime. The equations of motion are solved at first-order in the small-body spin for all classes of plunging orbits with energy $E < 1$. The solutions incorporate the small precession of the orbital plane caused by the precession of the particle's spin. Additionally, we present the correction to the radius of the innermost bound circular orbit in closed form, and introduce a novel, Keplerian-like parametrization for generic plunging orbits. Our solutions will be useful in the modelling of inspiral-merger-ringdown waveforms with self-force methods and black hole perturbation theory.

一句话导读：给出Kerr时空中近赤道坠落自旋测试粒子的自旋一阶解析轨道解，并用于黑洞波形建模。
