n维线性、二次和共形引力中的直积几何

Direct product geometries in $n$-dimensional linear, quadratic, and conformal gravity

Petr Jizba, Tereza Lehe\v{c}kov\'{a} · gr-qc, hep-th, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-11-10

中文摘要：直积时空为研究超越广义相对论的引力理论中的精确解提供了一条可行途径。本文研究(m1+m2)、(2+m)和(2+…+2)型n维直积时空，在线性引力、一般纯二次曲率引力和近期提出的一种高维共形引力扩展中，允许二维子空间具有非常数曲率。我们分类所得解空间，并确定允许的几何如何依赖于引力理论，以及在二次引力中如何依赖于曲率耦合。含非常数曲率二维部分的度规由曲率剖面的代数条件控制，或在二次引力的一个特殊类中由微分方程控制。仅含常数曲率m维子空间的度规关系是纯代数的。我们进一步考察与线性引力解的共形关系、广义Petrov型以及与电磁源的相容性。特别值得注意的是，对于n>4，所考虑形式的共形引力的直积扇区中不存在标准静态黑洞几何。文中详细分析了四维和六维情形，并在可能时给出说明所得结构的显式解析解。

English: Direct-product spacetimes offer a tractable route to exact solutions in gravity theories beyond general relativity. We study $n$-dimensional direct-product spacetimes of $(m_1+m_2)$, $(2+m)$, and $(2+\ldots+2)$ type in linear gravity, general pure quadratic-curvature gravity, and one of the recently proposed higher-dimensional extensions of conformal gravity, allowing the two-dimensional subspaces to have nonconstant curvature. We classify the resulting solution spaces and determine how the allowed geometries depend on the gravitational theory and, in quadratic gravity, on the curvature couplings. Metrics containing two-dimensional part(s) of nonconstant curvature are governed either by algebraic conditions on a curvature profile or, in one special class of quadratic gravity, by a differential equation. Relations governing metrics with only constant-curvature $m$-dimensional subspaces are purely algebraic. We further examine conformal relations to linear-gravity solutions, generalized Petrov types, and compatibility with electromagnetic sources. Particularly noteworthy is that standard static black-hole geometries are absent from the direct-product sector of the considered form of conformal gravity for $n>4$. Four- and six-dimensional cases are analyzed in detail, and explicit analytic solutions illustrating the resulting structure are presented whenever possible.

一句话导读：系统分类了n维直积时空在线性引力、纯二次曲率引力和共形引力中的精确解，并分析其与电磁源、Petrov型及共形关系的相容性。

标量-挠率-Maxwell平行引力中Reissner-Nordström黑洞的非线性标量化

Nonlinear Scalarization of Reissner-Nordstr\"om Black Holes in Scalar-Torsion-Maxwell Teleparallel Gravity

Joaqu\'in Robledo, Yerko V\'asquez, P. A. Gonz\'{a}lez · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-10

中文摘要：我们研究标量-挠率-Maxwell平行引力中Reissner-Nordström黑洞的非线性标量化，其中标量场与Weitzenböck不变量非最小耦合。我们考虑在线性层面避免快子不稳定的多项式耦合函数，从而探索由非线性效应驱动的标量化机制。在解耦极限下，我们研究有限振幅标量扰动的非线性演化，并表明引入六阶耦合项可使标量场动力学演化到非平凡稳态构型。该行为可用有效势理解，其发展出非平凡局域极小，提供非线性饱和机制。通过数值求解完全耦合场方程，我们构造带有标量毛的渐近平直带电黑洞解。我们根据标量场剖面的节点数分类这些解，识别出多支解，其结构和多重性依赖耦合参数。我们进一步表明高阶耦合逐渐抑制高节点支，并通过度规函数和挠率标量相对Reissner-Nordström背景的偏离刻画标量反作用。

English: We investigate the nonlinear scalarization of Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes in scalar-torsion-Maxwell teleparallel gravity, in which the scalar field is nonminimally coupled to the Weitzenb\"ock invariant. We consider polynomial coupling functions that avoid tachyonic instabilities at the linear level, thereby exploring a scalarization mechanism driven by nonlinear effects. In the decoupling limit, we study the nonlinear evolution of finite-amplitude scalar perturbations and show that the inclusion of a sixth-order coupling term allows the scalar field to dynamically evolve toward nontrivial stationary configurations. This behavior can be understood in terms of the effective potential, which develops nontrivial local minima that provide a mechanism for nonlinear saturation. By numerically solving the fully coupled field equations, we construct asymptotically flat charged black hole solutions endowed with scalar hair. We classify these solutions according to the number of nodes in the scalar field profile, identifying multiple branches whose structure and multiplicity depend on the coupling parameters. We further show that the higher-order coupling progressively suppresses higher-node branches and characterize the scalar backreaction through deviations of the metric functions and the torsion scalar from the Reissner-Nordstr\"om background.

一句话导读：在标量-挠率-Maxwell平行引力中，六阶耦合驱动RN黑洞非线性标量化并生成多支带毛带电黑洞解。

含PFDM与精质项的带电Letelier AdS黑洞的热力学、光学与波动特征

Thermodynamic, Optical, and Wave Signatures of Charged Letelier AdS Black Holes with PFDM and Quintessence

B. Eslam Panah, S. Gurtas Dogan, A. Guvendi, O. Mustafa · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-10

中文摘要：我们研究一个四维带电Letelier--反德西特（AdS）黑洞度规，其中包含弦云、唯象完美流体暗物质（PFDM）源和Kiselev型精质项。我们推导曲率不变量、视界温度、熵、电势和基于视界的质量函数，并分析局域热响应及相关的扩展相空间恒等式。一个矩形基准循环在明确给出的几何单位参数下给出 W=0.095000 和 η≈15.39%；这些值特定于模型和循环，并不作为普适效率增强呈现。对于几何光学，我们推导光子球条件、临界碰撞参数和有限半径阴影角。对于无质量最小耦合标量场，我们得到径向坐标的Helmholtz方程，并识别频率依赖的势垒、倏逝区间和候选捕获区域；eikonal势垒顶部尺度接近光子球捕获尺度。两条限定界定解释。第一，在所述PFDM应力张量约定下，ρ_PFDM=-β/(8πr^3)，因此正β描述负密度的有效源。第二，质量函数由视界方程得出，但要将其等同于守恒的渐近AdS质量，需要单独的电荷和边界归一化分析。势阱分析同样不能确定复准正规模频率。因此，我们将其结果呈现为对所采用唯象几何的一个一致的、特定参数的分析，同时区分代数热力学恒等式与需要渐近电荷或谱计算的结论。

English: We study a four-dimensional charged Letelier--anti-de Sitter (AdS) black-hole metric containing a cloud of strings, a phenomenological perfect-fluid-dark-matter (PFDM) source, and a Kiselev-type quintessence term. We derive the curvature invariants, horizon temperature, entropy, electric potential, and horizon-based mass function, and analyze local thermal response and the associated extended-phase-space identities. A rectangular benchmark cycle gives $W=0.095000$ and $\eta\simeq15.39\%$ for the explicitly stated geometric-unit parameters; these values are model- and cycle-specific and are not presented as a universal efficiency enhancement. For geometric optics, we derive the photon-sphere condition, critical impact parameter, and finite-radius shadow angle. For a massless, minimally coupled scalar field, we obtain a radial-coordinate Helmholtz equation and identify frequency-dependent barriers, evanescent intervals, and candidate trapping regions; the eikonal barrier-top scale approaches the photon-sphere capture scale. Two qualifications delimit the interpretation. First, with the stated PFDM stress-tensor convention, $\rho_{\rm PFDM}=-\beta/(8\pi r^3)$, so positive $\beta$ describes a negative-density effective source. Second, the mass function follows from the horizon equation, but identifying it with a conserved asymptotic AdS mass requires a separate charge and boundary-normalization analysis. The potential-well analysis likewise does not determine complex quasinormal frequencies. We therefore present the results as a consistent, parameter-specific analysis of the adopted phenomenological geometry, while distinguishing algebraic thermodynamic identities from conclusions requiring asymptotic-charge or spectral calculations.

English: The exact motion of a finite size object in curved spacetime is captured by the Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon equations. We provide a thorough review of this theory and show how to build it directly via a manifestly gauge invariant variational principle well-suited for effective descriptions of relativistic compact objects. We discuss conditions under which the covariant spin supplementary condition can be enforced and identify the natural basis of curvature tensors conjugate to the object's multipole moments.

中文摘要：我们构建了一类标量-张量实现，用于描述由具有有限核心和有限延展的量子相干态有效产生的球对称黑洞几何。我们确定了与 Einstein-Hilbert 拉格朗日量的非最小耦合、动能耦合和标量势，并表明动能项仅在有限区域内为正。对于固定黑洞质量，这些区域的边界提供了一种自然机制，将核心尺寸和空间延展与标量-张量实现的动力学联系起来。我们进一步表明，同一几何也可由具有导数耦合的 Horndeski 作用量得到，并确定了其适用范围。两种重构都不包含事件视界，也不能同时再现黑洞内部和外部的任意大部分区域，因此其量子起源似乎仍部分处于半经典引力理论适用范围之外。

English: We construct a scalar-tensor realisation of spherically symmetric black hole geometries that effectively arise from quantum coherent states characterised by a finite core and finite extension. We determine the non-minimal coupling to the Einstein-Hilbert Lagrangian, kinetic coupling, and scalar potential and show that the kinetic term is positive only in finite domains. For fixed black hole mass, the boundaries of these domains provide a natural mechanism that relates the core size and spatial extension to the dynamics of the scalar-tensor realisation. We further show that the same geometry can also be obtained from a Horndeski action with derivative coupling and determine its domain of validity. Neither reconstruction includes the event horizon nor can it simultaneously reproduce arbitrarily large portions of the interior and exterior of the black hole, whose quantum origin therefore appears to remain partially outside the regime of applicability of semiclassical theories of gravity.

Marek Li\v{s}ka, David Kubiznak · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-10

中文摘要：本文重新审视四维时空中Gauss-Bonnet拓扑项的热力学含义。文献中曾声称，该拓扑项虽然不改变运动方程，却会给黑洞熵带来一个与视界Euler示性数成正比的贡献。作者认为这一结论依赖于视界上边界作用量的选择，并指出存在一种选择，使得Wald熵表达式即使对非稳态黑洞也自然复现Jacobson-Myers熵。文章还表明，对于光滑外边界，无论边界条件或时空渐近行为如何选择，守恒量都不会得到额外贡献。此外，作者证明拓扑Gauss-Bonnet项会改变Hawking-Page相变的临界温度，从而原则上提供探测其在引力作用量中存在的方式；对于正的Gauss-Bonnet耦合常数，他们在高温高压下观察到零阶Hawking相变。虽然讨论集中于四维Gauss-Bonnet项，但结果更一般，并定性地适用于其他Lovelock拉格朗日量在其临界维度中的情形。

English: We revisit the thermodynamic implications of the Gauss-Bonnet topological term in four spacetime dimensions. It has been previously claimed in the literature that this term, although it does not modify the equations of motion, shifts the black hole entropy by a contribution proportional to the Euler characteristic of the horizon. We argue that this conclusion is sensitive to the choice of the boundary action on the horizon. We then identify a choice for which the Wald entropy expression naturally reproduces the Jacobson-Myers entropy, even for non-stationary black holes. We also show that there are no further contributions to conserved quantities from smooth outer boundaries, regardless of the choice of boundary conditions there and of the asymptotic behaviour of the spacetime. Moreover, we demonstrate that the topological Gauss-Bonnet term changes the critical temperature of the Hawking-Page phase transition, opening, in principle, a way for detecting its presence in the gravitational action. In fact, for a positive Gauss-Bonnet coupling constant, we observe a zeroth-order Hawking phase transition at high temperatures and pressures. While our discussion focuses on the case of the Gauss-Bonnet term in 4D, the results are more general and qualitatively apply to other Lovelock Lagrangians in their respective critical dimensions.

English: We investigate cubic curvature corrections to four-dimensional Taub-NUT-AdS black holes and their thermodynamics. English: Coleman found plane waves of Yang--Mills theory that are genuinely non-abelian in four dimensions and yet obey linear field equations, and G\"uven showed that they remain exact when gravity is included. We study these waves in $D$ dimensions. In anti-de Sitter space, we construct a closed-form family for every $D\geq4$; there, the full Riemann tensor cannot equal this color square. Waves whose transverse space is a sphere are always singular. In quadratic and Gauss--Bonnet gravity, a hyperbolic transverse space avoids this only if the waves defocus light or the higher-curvature terms become comparable to the Einstein term. All solutions extend, with changed coefficients, to generic gravity and gauge theories.

We demonstrate pronounced critical slowing down in the dual CFT, characterized by an enhancement of the autocorrelation time and stochastic fluctuations, accompanied by a suppression of the lowest nonzero Fokker-Planck eigenvalue. The autocorrelation time exhibits a universal power-law divergence, $\tau\sim|\epsilon|^{-\Delta}$, with $\Delta\simeq 2/3$, consistent with the analytical prediction and previous bulk gravitational results. Going beyond the conventional single-parameter analysis, we incorporate variations of the CFT central charge and identify a combined scaling variable involving temperature and central charge, demonstrating that the leading relaxation dynamics retain the same critical exponent along different trajectories in the two-dimensional parameter space. Finally, we explore the interplay between thermodynamic relaxation and quantum information scrambling by comparing the relaxation timescale with the fast-scrambling timescale. The comparison reveals a crossover between thermodynamic relaxation and quantum scrambling for which we derive the corresponding crossover scale analytically and find that, in the large-central-charge limit, it behaves as $\hat{\epsilon}\sim(C\ln C)^{-3/2}$. We also verify this numerically using the full nonlinear free-energy landscape. Our results connect critical dynamical scaling, finite-central-charge effects, and quantum scrambling within the holographic CFT framework.

English: We investigate the effect of a quartic scalar self-interaction, $\lambda|\phi|^4$, on a holographic superconductor in which non-linear electrodynamic couplings generate a superconducting dome containing an extended Lifshitz regime. The quartic interaction leaves the linearized scalar dynamics around the normal phase unchanged while modifying the non-linear solutions where the scalar field is large. As $\lambda$ increases, the solutions within the dome pass through three stages. The Lifshitz region shrinks until its scaling solution disappears at $\lambda^*$, leaving a no-AdS region, beyond whose edge the flows end before reaching any asymptotic region, and above $\lambda_c$ the dome consists entirely of asymptotically AdS hairy black holes. At the bottom of the dome we identify the point where the horizon value of the scalar field is largest, which we refer to as the critical point. There this value lies at the deepest symmetry-breaking minimum that the horizon effective potential, of Landau-Ginzburg form, can have. Unlike a conventional Landau-Ginzburg description, this interpretation rests on the scalar field at the horizon rather than on the boundary order parameter. Below $\lambda^*$, the constant scalar of the Lifshitz fixed point sits instead at the minimum of the effective potential of its asymptotic scaling region.

English: We present a prescription for identifying decoupled sectors of 4d SCFTs obtained from compactifications of branes. Central to our analysis is the comparison of anomaly polynomials obtained via field-theoretic reduction versus anomaly inflow. Our flagship examples are the 4d $\mathcal{N}=1$ SCFTs obtained by compactifying the 6d $(1,0)$ theory from M5-branes probing a $\mathbb{C}^2/\mathbb{Z}_2$ orbifold singularity on a torus with flux. The anomaly polynomial of the interacting fixed point is known to decompose into the $T^2$ reduction of the 6d anomaly polynomial, plus a contribution from flip fields introduced to remove operators from the spectrum. Adopting the inflow perspective, the contribution from the flipped sector is obtained as the difference between inflow anomaly polynomials in the singular and resolved geometries, which we efficiently compute using equivariant localization. Helpfully, the 4d SCFTs admit two dual quiver gauge theory descriptions: $Y^{p,q}$ quiver gauge theories, and class $\mathcal{S}_2$ necklace quivers obtained from trinions. We study the interacting and decoupled sectors on both sides of the duality and construct an explicit map between their chiral rings, identifying a range of parameter space for which the quivers flow to apparently different interacting fixed points. Each chiral ring generator is furthermore matched to an M2-brane wrapping a 2-cycle in the resolved M-theory geometry.

中文摘要：研究相同标量主算符的四点函数在固定 0<z,\bar z<1 且维度 Δ 增大时的行为；若其指数增长率与广义自由场相同，则称其被解放，正如沿 AdS 测地线传播的重自由粒子。证明在交叉对称点解放当且仅当轻谱稀疏，且此时只要 z 与 \bar z 位于 1/2 同侧便处处解放。若低 twist 态也稀疏，则除 z+\bar z=1 附近显式带外处处解放；若主算符 twist gap 高于 \sqrt{2}Δ，则处处解放。低于 Δ 的 twist 截断下，两个自旋广义自由场的复合在双光锥极限附近带内失效。二维中 Virasoro 主算符除非中心电荷增长快于 Δ 否则不能解放。该框架还锐化二维 CFT 大 c 环面配分函数的普适性。

English: We study CFT four-point functions of identical scalar primaries as their dimension $\Delta$ grows for fixed $0<z, \bar z<1$, and call them liberated if they grow at the same exponential rate as those of a generalized free field (GFF), as is the case for heavy free particles propagating along geodesics in AdS. We show that the correlator is liberated at the crossing symmetric point if and only if the light spectrum is sparse, and that liberation then holds wherever $z$ and $\bar z$ lie on the same side of $1/2$. If the low twist states are also sparse, liberation holds everywhere except in an explicit band around $z+\bar z=1$. In particular, if the primary twist gap lies above $\sqrt{2}\Delta$, then the correlator is liberated everywhere. For twist cutoffs below $\Delta$, composites of two spinning generalized free fields fail to be liberated in a region that fills the band near the double lightcone limit. In two dimensions, Virasoro primaries cannot be liberated unless the central charge grows faster than $\Delta$. The same framework sharpens the universality of large-$c$ torus partition functions of two-dimensional CFTs.

中文摘要：考虑STU模型中带三个R荷q1,q2,q3的黑膜解。等R荷时退化为Reissner-Nordström黑膜；不等R荷q1>q2>q3≥0时，在R≡r^2=-q_i处有三个曲率奇异点，仅R=-q3为物理奇异点，另两个位于其外部。定义光学时间T_i为从边界到这些奇异点再返回的零射线复时间，它们在复T平面构成直角三角形。利用零空间动量下T_xy推迟关联函数构造的三个观测量——谱函数、OPE系数和QNM——探测这些奇异点。大实频率下谱函数的指数小修正由Im T_i最小的T1和T2主导；OPE收敛半径由|T_i|最小的T1决定；一条QNM线沿1/T2方向，因为T2的相位最小；另一条QNM线沿负虚轴，携带对应物理奇异点T3的信息。作者通过WKB分析推导并用数值验证这些结果，表明三个观测量对不同几何奇异点敏感。

English: We consider black brane solutions in the STU model, with three R-charges labeled by the parameters $q_1,q_2,q_3$. For equal R-charges $q_1=q_2=q_3$, the solution becomes the Reissner-Nordstr\"om black brane. For unequal R-charges $q_1>q_2>q_3\geq0$, there are three curvature singular points at $R\equiv r^2=-q_i$. Only $R=-q_3$ is the physical singularity, and the other two lie beyond it. Their optical times $T_i$, the complex times of null rays from the boundary to these singular points and back, form a right triangle in the complex $T$-plane. We probe these singular points using three observables, all built from the retarded correlator of $T_{xy}$ at zero spatial momentum: spectral function, OPE coefficients, and QNMs. The exponentially small correction to the spectral function at large real frequency is dominated by $T_1$ and $T_2$, which have the smallest ${\rm Im}\,T_i$. The OPE convergence radius is determined by $T_1$, which has the smallest $|T_i|$. A line of QNMs lies along the direction of $1/T_2$, since $T_2$ has the smallest phase $\arg T_i$. Furthermore, there is a second line of QNMs along the negative imaginary axis, which carries information about $T_3$ corresponding to the physical singularity. We derive these results from a WKB analysis and check them numerically. The three observables are therefore sensitive to different singular points of the geometry.

At leading nontrivial order, the Einstein equations reduce to a closed set of non-relativistic hydrodynamic equations in four dimensions, as first shown in our previous letter; these equations generalize the large-D effective theory of black branes. We also show how the near-horizon geometry can be completed by a holographic flow to an asymptotically AdS5 region. Kristiansen Lara, Ricardo Troncoso · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-10

中文摘要：考虑 AdS3 上广义相对论的新边界条件：在 Einstein-Hilbert 作用量中加入不改变真空场方程的宇称奇项后，正则生成元获得非线性贡献，其代数仍为 Virasoro 与 u(1) Kac-Moody 的半直和，但中心扩张发生移动。适当选择宇称奇耦合可使 Kac-Moody 能级非负，从而容许幺正表示；然而黑洞熵非负要求该能级非正，二者兼容仅留下能级为零的情形。该情形下场方程退化，可通过施加零挠率约束修正，此时理论恰为手征点的拓扑大规模引力，暗示需扩展边界条件以容纳非平凡对数支。

English: We consider recently introduced boundary conditions for General Relativity on AdS$_3$, whose canonical generators span the warped conformal algebra, in the case of the Einstein-Hilbert action supplemented by parity-odd terms that do not modify the field equations in vacuum. The canonical generators are shown to acquire nonlinear contributions, and their algebra remains being the semidirect sum of Virasoro and $u(1)$ Kac-Moody, but with shifted central extensions. Thus, for suitable values of the parity-odd coupling, the Kac-Moody level can be nonnegative ($k_\text{KM}\geq 0$), admitting unitary representations. Nevertheless, requiring the black hole entropy to be nonnegative, implies $k_\text{KM}\leq 0$, in agreement with the established understanding of holographic warped CFTs. Compatibility of both requirements (entropy and unitarity) then singles out the case $k_\text{KM}=0$. However, the field equations degenerate in this case, which can be amended by imposing vanishing torsion as a constraint. The theory then precisely becomes Topologically Massive Gravity (TMG) at the chiral point, suggesting the extension of our boundary conditions to accommodate nontrivial logarithmic branches.

Emergent de Sitter Universes in Non-Hermitian Holography

Daniel Are\'an, Suman Das, David Garcia-Fari\~na, Juan F. Pedraza · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-10

中文摘要：我们构造一类渐近反德西特（AdS）的正则黑洞，其内部演化为非奇异、膨胀的德西特（dS）宇宙。该构造依赖于非厄米全息，其中零能量条件的违反允许内部几何经历光滑反弹并趋近晚期 dS 吸引子。该宇宙学在单一事件视界后动态涌现，延伸到类空未来边界 I+，无需引入辅助膜或粘合不同几何。这为探索三种互补全息视角之间的联系提供新场景：AdS 边界上的非厄米共形场论（CFT）、I+ 处假想的欧几里得 CFT（dS/CFT）以及观测者中心的静态片全息。值得注意的是，锚定在 AdS 边界上的可观测量揭示了与这些互补 dS 全息概念的具体联系。因此，我们的构造提供了一个新的全息实验室，用于系统探索未来边界和静态片描述如何在已建立的 AdS/CFT 框架内涌现。

English: We construct a class of asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS), regular black holes whose interiors evolve into nonsingular, expanding de Sitter (dS) cosmologies. Our construction relies on non-Hermitian holography, where violations of the null energy condition allow the interior geometry to undergo a smooth bounce and approach a late-time dS attractor. The cosmology emerges dynamically behind a single event horizon, extending to a spacelike future boundary, $\mathcal I^+$, without introducing auxiliary branes or gluing distinct geometries. This provides a novel setting to explore the connections between three complementary holographic perspectives: a non-Hermitian conformal field theory (CFT) at the AdS boundaries, a putative Euclidean CFT at $\mathcal I^+$ (dS/CFT), and observer-centered static-patch holography. Remarkably, observables anchored at the AdS boundaries reveal concrete connections with these complementary notions of dS holography. Our construction thus offers a new holographic laboratory for systematically exploring how future-boundary and static-patch descriptions of dS quantum gravity may emerge within the established setting of AdS/CFT.

一句话导读：构造非厄米全息下渐近 AdS 正则黑洞，其内部动态涌现非奇异 dS 宇宙并连接 dS/CFT 与静态片全息。

混合通量 AdS3 中的可积 AdS2 膜

Integrable AdS$_2$ branes in mixed flux AdS$_3$

Davide Bonomi, Volker Schomerus · hep-th, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-11-10

中文摘要：我们证明，在带有混合 NSNS 与 RR 通量的 AdS3×S3×T4 中，包裹 AdS2×S2 的半 BPS D3 膜为 Green–Schwarz 超弦的超陪集 sigma 模型定义了可积边界条件。这将 Dekel 和 Oz 的可积 D 膜推广到含 Wess–Zumino 项的背景，并把此前关于混合通量的玻色结果推广到完整超弦。利用 D3 膜作用量，我们发现使膜稳定在一般位置的电/磁世界体场，可由 WZW 模型 AdS2×S2 膜的相应场通过同一 SL(2,R) 旋转得到；该旋转把纯 NSNS 背景映射到混合通量背景，并在 D3 膜上表现为电磁对偶。在世界面上，消去费米边界项需要在边界作用量中引入一个特定的闭二形式，而它对玻色边界条件的贡献正好重现这些世界体场。随后我们构造依赖场的反射矩阵，将边界条件提升为 Cagnazzo–Zarembo Lax 联络的粘合条件，并描述沿垂直于膜的法向测地线的位移。所得双行单值矩阵产生无穷多守恒荷，从而确立了任意通量混合下开超弦的经典可积性。在 AdS3/CFT2 中，这些膜预期对偶于 T4 对称积 orbifold 的一个形变中的共形界面。

English: We show that half-BPS D3-branes wrapping AdS$_2\times$S$^2$ in AdS$_3\times$S$^3\times$T$^4$ with mixed NSNS and RR flux define integrable boundary conditions for the supercoset sigma model of the Green--Schwarz superstring. This extends the integrable D-branes of Dekel and Oz to backgrounds with a Wess--Zumino term, and previous bosonic results for mixed flux to the full superstring. Using the D3-brane action, we find that the electric and magnetic worldvolume fields that stabilise the branes at generic positions are obtained from those of the AdS$_2\times$S$^2$ branes of the WZW model by the same $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ rotation that maps the pure NSNS background to the mixed flux one, acting on the D3-brane as electric--magnetic duality. On the worldsheet, cancelling the fermionic boundary terms requires introducing a specific closed two-form in the boundary action, and its contribution to the bosonic boundary conditions reproduces precisely these worldvolume fields. We then construct field-dependent reflection matrices that lift the boundary conditions to gluing conditions for the Cagnazzo--Zarembo Lax connection and describe displacements along geodesics normal to the brane. The resulting double-row monodromy matrix generates infinitely many conserved charges, which establishes the classical integrability of the open superstring for any mixture of fluxes. In AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$, these branes are expected to be dual to conformal interfaces in a deformation of the symmetric product orbifold of T$^4$.

一句话导读：该文证明混合通量 AdS3×S3×T4 中包裹 AdS2×S2 的半 BPS D3 膜给出可积边界条件，并构造反射矩阵与无穷守恒荷。

婴儿宇宙通过向边界隐藏观察者而成核

Baby Universes Nucleate by Hiding Observers from the Boundary

Sergio E. Aguilar-Gutierrez, Takato Mori · hep-th, gr-qc, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-11-10

中文摘要：研究两个由四参数相互作用耦合的双标度SYK模型（含广义Maldacena-Qi耦合），在含观察者（以粒子表示）的态中。重粒子使连接两系统的虫洞只能增长；哈密顿量弦的稀有产物抵消粒子弦，闭合婴儿宇宙携带观察者，空虫洞恢复有限长度离散态。空虫洞获得能量支付观察者熵，形成一级相变，潜热为转变温度乘该熵。Krylov复杂度度量虫洞长度，在转变处下降，从边界探测婴儿宇宙出现；边界也失去关于观察者微观态的Holevo信息。

English: Observers are expected to be essential to describe closed universes, but their description within a conventional holographic theory remains challenging. We study two double-scaled Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev models coupled by a four-parameter interaction, which includes a generalized Maldacena-Qi coupling, in a state that contains an observer, represented as a particle. With a heavy particle inside, the wormhole connecting the two systems can only grow. Rare products of Hamiltonian strings cancel the string of the particle: a closed baby universe then carries the observer, and the wormhole, now empty, recovers discrete states of finite length. The energy gained by the empty wormhole pays for the entropy of the observer, in a first-order transition whose latent heat is the transition temperature times this entropy. Krylov complexity, which measures the wormhole length, drops at the transition and thus detects from the boundary the emergence of the baby universe, whose boundary description is actively debated. The boundary also loses the Holevo information about the microstates of the observer, which the baby universe carries.

一句话导读：在双标度SYK耦合虫洞中，携带观察者的婴儿宇宙通过一级相变成核，Krylov复杂度与Holevo信息从边界标记其出现。

离散 Jackiw--Teitelboim 引力中边界对称性的自由场实现

A Free-Field Realization of Boundary Symmetries in Discrete Jackiw--Teitelboim Gravity

H. T. \"Ozer, Ayt\"ul Filiz · hep-th, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-11-10

中文摘要：我们研究一个有限周期的 Miura 自由场实现，它对应于与 sl(2,R) Jackiw--Teitelboim (JT) 引力相关的经典 Virasoro--dilaton 扇区。从一个对数 Cartan 场出发，我们利用已有的离散 Miura 映射及其自由场 Poisson 括号来构造格点自旋二流。随后，dilaton 被实现为同一组 Cartan 变量的周期复合体，并由一个非齐次差分方程及其单值性条件选取。该构造给出显式的诱导混合 Poisson 括号，而无需假设一个独立的 dilaton 括号。我们考察相关的转移问题和二次伴随不变量，并用连续 Virasoro--dilaton 变换检验有限 Fourier 代数，其中 dilaton 的共形权重为负一。该构造提供了 JT 边界变换律的自由场对应物；它本身并不将 Miura Poisson 结构与正则 BF 边界荷代数等同起来。

English: We investigate a finite-periodic Miura free-field realization of the classical Virasoro--dilaton sector relevant to sl(2,R) Jackiw--Teitelboim (JT) gravity. Starting from a single logarithmic Cartan field, we use the established discrete Miura map and its free-field Poisson bracket to construct the lattice spin-two current. The dilaton is then realized as a periodic composite of the same Cartan variables, selected by an inhomogeneous difference equation and its monodromy condition. This construction yields an explicit induced mixed Poisson bracket without postulating an independent dilaton bracket. We examine the associated transfer problem and quadratic adjoint invariant, and test the finite Fourier algebra against the continuous Virasoro--dilaton transformation, in which the dilaton has conformal weight minus one. The construction supplies a free-field counterpart of the JT boundary transformation laws; it does not by itself identify the Miura Poisson structure with the canonical BF boundary-charge algebra.

一句话导读：用离散 Miura 自由场构造 JT 引力的 Virasoro--dilaton 边界对称性，并导出混合 Poisson 括号。

度规变分下Cauchy演化的微局部性质

Microlocal properties of Cauchy evolution under metric variations

Alexander Strohmaier · math.AP, math-ph, math.DG, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-11-10

中文摘要：本文发展无限维洛伦兹度规空间上波型方程Cauchy演化的微局部分析。作者将Cauchy演化算子视为度规的分布函数，并通过限制到有限维度规族赋予该概念精确含义，研究这种度规依赖的奇点。对于向量丛上的正规双曲算子，文章确定相应的算子值波前集，其参数余向量由沿单条零测地线的度规变分积分给出。在超静态端，度规依赖还决定时间平移生成元及其正负能量分裂。更一般地，参数奇点区分两支特征叶，并可用于重构描述奇点传播的普通Cauchy传播关系。结果包括参数平均下的光滑化以及与平均零正变分相关的极锥界，从而联系到平均零能量条件。分析还涵盖Dirac方程的Cauchy演化。

English: We develop the microlocal analysis of the Cauchy evolution for wave-type equations on the infinite-dimensional space of Lorentzian metrics. We regard the Cauchy evolution operator as a distributional function of the metric, and give this notion a precise meaning through restrictions to finite-dimensional families of metrics. We study the singularities of this metric dependence. For normally hyperbolic operators on vector bundles, we determine the resulting operator-valued wavefront sets. Their parameter covectors are given by integrals of metric variations along individual null geodesics. At ultrastatic ends, metric dependence also determines the time-translation generators and their positive- and negative-energy splitting. More generally, the parameter singularities distinguish the two characteristic sheets and can be used to reconstruct the ordinary Cauchy propagation relation, which describes propagation of singularities. Consequences include smoothing under parameter averaging and polar-cone bounds associated with averaged null-positive variations, linking the result to averaged null energy conditions. The analysis also covers the Cauchy evolution of the Dirac equation.

一句话导读：研究洛伦兹度规变分下波方程与Dirac方程Cauchy演化的微局部奇点及其与零测地线和平均零能量条件的联系。

作为黑洞模仿者的虫洞的潮汐Love数

Tidal Love numbers of wormholes as black-hole mimickers

Sergey N. Solodukhin, Vagif Tagiev · gr-qc, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：本文研究可作为黑洞可行模仿者的虫洞的动态标量潮汐Love数，聚焦于薄壳Schwarzschild与Damour-Solodukhin几何。采用近区和远区匹配展开，确定低频区域中的潮汐响应。长喉的存在引入额外特征尺度，并将模式自然分为两类：超喉模式探测虫洞整体几何并对两个渐近区域敏感；亚喉模式只探测虫洞一侧，并有效将喉视为黑洞视界。我们解析给出两类模式的标量潮汐Love数，并表明其耗散部分呈现不同的低频行为，反映散射过程中是一个还是两个势垒参与。进一步发现，当虫洞趋近黑洞极限时，超喉贡献逐渐可忽略，而亚喉响应平滑退化为Schwarzschild黑洞的响应。这些结果表明，虫洞的潮汐响应关键取决于扰动是否探测喉的全局结构。

English: We study the dynamical scalar tidal Love numbers of wormholes that provide viable mimickers for black holes, focusing on thin-shell Schwarzschild and Damour-Solodukhin geometries. Using a matched near- and far-zone expansion, we determine their tidal response in the low-frequency regime. The presence of a long throat introduces an additional characteristic scale and naturally separates the modes into two classes. Super-throat modes probe the global wormhole geometry and are sensitive to both asymptotic regions, whereas sub-throat modes probe only one side of the wormhole and effectively perceive the throat as a black-hole horizon. We derive the scalar tidal Love numbers analytically for both classes of modes and show that their dissipative parts exhibit distinct low-frequency behavior, reflecting whether one or both potential barriers participate in the scattering process. We further find that, as the wormhole approaches the black-hole limit, the super-throat contribution becomes progressively negligible, while the sub-throat response smoothly reduces to that of a Schwarzschild black hole. These results demonstrate that the tidal response of wormholes depends crucially on whether the perturbation probes the global structure of the throat.

一句话导读：该文用近远区匹配方法计算薄壳虫洞的标量潮汐Love数，区分超喉与亚喉模式，并显示其在黑洞极限下退化为Schwarzschild响应。

重整化群改进的史瓦西黑洞：阴影、铃宕与强宇宙监督

Renormalization-group improved Schwarzschild black hole: shadow, ringdown, and strong cosmic censorship

Ahmad Al-Badawi, Faizuddin Ahmed, \.Izzet Sakall{\i} · gr-qc, hep-th · v5 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：本文研究一种重整化群改进的类史瓦西黑洞，其 lapse 在经典史瓦西外部与由截断能标 ξ 和插值参数 γ 确定的量子平滑内部之间插值。作者给出视界结构、光子球和阴影半径 R_sh，统一建立标量、电磁和 Dirac 的 Regge-Wheeler-Zerilli 问题，并用六阶 WKB 计算基频与泛音准正模，再用时域铃宕交叉检验。对于 ξ>0、γ>0，几何正则并具有 de Sitter 核。文章在内 Cauchy 视界检验强宇宙监督；该改进几何无需电荷或转动即可产生内 Cauchy 视界。准正模谱隙 β=|Im ω|/κ_- 在多极矩间保持在约 6% 水平，并满足 β≃λ_L/(2κ_-)，在整个参数范围内低于 de Sitter Christodoulou 界，渐近平直晚时尾使该几何属于尊重 SCC 的类别。热力学分析指出外视界的 Davies 型相变，史瓦西 T_H∝1/r_+ 衰减被峰值在 T_H^max≃0.062 的钟形曲线取代。文章扫描 (ξ,γ) 平面，汇总阴影、标量势垒、SCC 比值和 T_H 的联合行为，并在匹配扰动尺度下与 Bardeen、Hayward 和 Bonanno-Reuter 黑洞比较；改进史瓦西黑洞是正则黑洞家族中最接近史瓦西的，其静态阴影半径与 Hayward 和 Bonanno-Reuter 在百分级上简并。最后分析 Hawking 通量稀疏度和能量发射率，二者通过单一辅助函数与外视界表面引力相联系。

English: A renormalization-group (RG) improved Schwarzschild-like black hole (BH) is studied here, with a lapse that interpolates between a classical Schwarzschild exterior and a quantum-smoothed interior set by a cutoff scale $\xi$ and an interpolation parameter $\gamma$. We work out the horizon structure together with the photon sphere and shadow radius $R_{\mathrm{sh}}$, set up the scalar, electromagnetic, and Dirac Regge-Wheeler-Zerilli problems in a single treatment, and compute the fundamental and overtone quasinormal modes by sixth-order WKB, cross-checked against time-domain ringdown. For $\xi>0$ and $\gamma>0$ the geometry is regular, with a de Sitter core. Strong Cosmic Censorship (SCC) is examined at the inner Cauchy horizon, which the improved geometry generates without charge or rotation. The quasinormal spectral gap $\beta=|\mathrm{Im}\,\omega|/\kappa_-$ stays multipole-independent at the $6\%$ level and follows $\beta\simeq\lambda_{L}/(2\kappa_{-})$. It remains below the de Sitter Christodoulou bound across the parameter range, and the asymptotically flat late-time tail places the geometry in the SCC-respecting class. A thermodynamic analysis identifies a Davies-type phase transition of the outer horizon, with the Schwarzschild $T_{H}\propto 1/r_{+}$ decay replaced by a bell-curve profile peaking at $T_{H}^{\max}\simeq 0.062$. A scan of the $(\xi,\gamma)$ plane gathers the joint behavior of the shadow, the scalar barrier, the SCC ratio, and $T_H$. Set against Bardeen, Hayward, and Bonanno-Reuter BHs at matched perturbation scale, the improved Schwarzschild BH is the most Schwarzschild-like of the regular-BH family, its static shadow radius degenerate with Hayward and Bonanno-Reuter at the percent level. The closing analysis takes up the sparsity of the Hawking flux and the energy-emission rate, both tied to the outer-horizon surface gravity through a single auxiliary function.

一句话导读：研究RG改进史瓦西黑洞的阴影、准正模、强宇宙监督与Davies型热力学相变。

广义相对论小 c 展开中的稳态解

Stationary solutions in the small-$c$ expansion of GR

Enes Bal, Ertu\u{g}rul Ekiz, Emre Onur Kahya, Utku Zorba · gr-qc, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：本文在 ADM 变量下研究广义相对论的小 c 展开，并推进到次次领头阶（NNLO）。我们表明，在稳态部分，这一表述使场方程更便于显式构造解。稳态方程呈现出如下结构：领头阶的 lapse 与空间度规由一个闭合子系统确定，NLO 转动场在该背景上满足线性方程，而 NNLO 场则满足由 NLO 数据作为源的线性系统。稳态部分同时具有强引力支和弱场支，其结构在 NNLO 变得更丰富。在强引力支中，我们首先得到 NLO Carroll 引力的精确真空解，包括 Lense-Thirring 背景和转动的 C-metric 背景；在 NNLO，我们构造相应的 Lense-Thirring 型和 C-metric 型精确真空几何。这些解也可由 Kerr 和转动 C-metric 几何围绕强引力背景的小 c 展开得到，NLO 精确到 O(J)，NNLO 精确到 O(J^3)。在弱场支中，我们找到具有独立四极矩的精确 Hartle-Thorne 型解，以及精确的自旋平方修正和混合的四极-转动解。我们进一步将 ℓ=0,2 部分扩展到 ℓ=4 的更高多极。结果表明，完整的 NLO/NNLO 理论具有比磁 Carroll 截断更丰富的稳态真空部分。更广泛地说，ADM 表述为在小 c 展开中构造和分析稳态背景提供了实用框架，也可能为组织由相对论致密天体几何启发的转动与高阶多极形变提供有用框架。

English: We study the small-$c$ expansion of general relativity in ADM variables up to next-to-next-to-leading order (NNLO). We show that, in the stationary sector, this formulation renders the field equations more tractable for explicit solution building. The stationary equations acquire a structure, in which the leading lapse and spatial metric are determined by a closed subsystem, the NLO rotational field satisfies a linear equation on that background, and the NNLO fields satisfy a linear system sourced by the NLO data. The stationary sector exhibits both strong-gravity and weak-field branches, whose structure becomes richer at NNLO. In the strong-gravity branch, we first obtain exact vacuum solutions of NLO Carroll gravity, including the Lense--Thirring and rotating C-metric backgrounds. At NNLO, we then construct the corresponding Lense--Thirring-type and C-metric-type exact vacuum geometries. These solutions also arise from the small-$c$ expansion of the Kerr and rotating C-metric geometries around the strong-gravity background, up to $\mathcal{O}(J)$ at NLO and up to $\mathcal{O}(J^3)$ at NNLO. In the weak-field branch, we find exact Hartle--Thorne-type solutions with an independent quadrupole moment, together with exact spin-squared corrections and a mixed quadrupolar-rotating solution. We further extend the $\ell=0,2$ sector by including higher multipoles up to $\ell=4$, where $\ell$ denotes the multipole index. 中文摘要：彭罗斯的弱宇宙监督猜想断言，引力坍缩产生的时空奇点通常被事件视界遮蔽，从而不会因果影响远处观察者，并保持外部区域的预言性。本文通过考虑负能量密度的幻影标量场球对称坍缩，故意违反该猜想的核心假设之一——主能量条件，来检验这一猜想。原则上，这种场可产生负质量的 Schwarzschild 几何，因而没有事件视界。我们的目标是评估：一旦放弃主能量条件，物质与几何的全耦合演化能否动力学地产生或暴露裸奇点，从而检验宇宙监督的稳健性。为此，我们基于四阶有限差分格式进行高精度数值相对论模拟。从代表规则幻影标量波包的光滑、渐近平直初值出发，我们跟踪其经过坍缩或色散的全非线性演化。普通正能标量场在黑洞形成阈值处表现出标准的 Choptuik 临界行为，而幻影场显示定性不同的动力学。对于所考虑的所有振幅，我们没有发现 trapped surface、裸奇点或替代稳态的证据。相反，在所研究的所有构型中，幻影标量场均色散。在所探索的参数空间内，我们没有发现宇宙监督的动力学违反。

English: Penrose's weak cosmic censorship conjecture asserts that spacetime singularities produced by gravitational collapse are generically hidden behind event horizons, thus preventing them from causally influencing distant observers and preserving the predictability of the exterior region. In this work, we probe this conjecture in a setup that deliberately violates one of its central assumptions - the dominant energy condition - by considering the spherical collapse of a phantom scalar field with negative energy density. In principle, such a field could produce a Schwarzschild geometry with negative mass and therefore no event horizon. Our aim is to assess whether, once the dominant energy condition is abandoned, the fully coupled evolution of matter and geometry can dynamically generate or expose naked singularities, thereby probing the robustness of cosmic censorship. To this end, we perform high-accuracy numerical relativity simulations based on fourth-order finite-difference schemes. Starting from smooth, asymptotically flat initial data representing regular phantom scalar wave packets, we follow their fully nonlinear evolution through collapse or dispersion. While an ordinary (positive-energy) scalar field exhibits the standard Choptuik critical behavior at the threshold of black-hole formation, the phantom field displays qualitatively different dynamics. For all amplitudes considered, we find no evidence for trapped surfaces, naked singularities, or alternative stationary end states. Instead, the phantom scalar field disperses in all the configurations studied. Within the parameter space explored, we find no dynamical violation of cosmic censorship.

English: We propose a new thermodynamic inequality for stationary, asymptotically Anti-de Sitter rotating black holes, expressed in terms of their angular momentum, mass and thermodynamic volume as $ 4\pi J^2/(3MV)<1 $. For the solutions considered, this inequality follows from the requirement that the thermodynamic identities admit a physical horizon with positive area. We then reformulate the inequality in terms of the underlying metric parameters and compare the resulting constraints with the corresponding regularity and horizon-existence conditions. This analysis shows that the proposed inequality has different physical content for different geometries. Moreover, when combined with the refined reverse isoperimetric inequality, the proposed bound ensures the physicality of the Kerr-AdS reference solution entering the refined bound and thereby yields the conventional reverse isoperimetric inequality. We also extend the proposed relation to higher dimensions and test it for singly spinning thin AdS black ring with nonspherical horizon topology, finding that the corresponding inequalities are satisfied throughout the thin-ring regime.

English: We derive the generalized Schwarzian thermodynamics of near-extremal Kerr directly from four-dimensional gravitational perturbations of the near-horizon geometry. We construct two families of exact linear perturbations of the near-NHEK background: a non-normalizable mode that deforms the asymptotic boundary, and a normalizable mode supported near the horizon. Both perturbations are smooth solutions of the vacuum Einstein equations reduced to the Jackiw--Teitelboim equation for the dual scalar, without conical singularities. We study their asymptotic symmetries and show that they generate an algebra of time reparametrizations; requiring the gauge parameters to depend on the Schwarzian mode, the isometry condition selects the stationary KdV hierarchy. The same hierarchy is independently enforced by the vacuum Einstein equations on the perturbation coefficient. In the Euclidean regime, we evaluate the Hamiltonian action and show that each mode independently generates a tower of odd-power corrections to the near-extremal entropy.

English: We present an alternative formulation of coupled gravitational and electromagnetic perturbations of Kerr--Newman--de Sitter black holes, yielding decoupled radial and angular equations with a well-defined $\Lambda\rightarrow 0$ limit. We compute the quasinormal mode spectra using spectral and direct integration methods, finding excellent agreement. All of these modes are consistent with the linear stability of the Kerr--Newman--de Sitter black hole. We investigate the photon sphere and near-extremal modes, revealing a non-trivial interplay between rotation and electric charge. We further explore the implications for the strong cosmic censorship conjecture and find that the photon sphere modes predominantly determine its validity within the parameter space considered. While increasing the rotation of the black hole generally favours the strong cosmic censorship conjecture, increasing the electric charge can promote its violation. We also find that the region of parameter space exhibiting a violation of the conjecture is comparatively smaller for gravitational perturbations than for electromagnetic perturbations. These results highlight the important role of rotation, electric charge, and the nature of perturbations in determining the validity of the strong cosmic censorship conjecture in Kerr--Newman--de Sitter spacetimes.

English: We present new developments in the mathematical foundations and numerical simulations of the causal and stable first-order relativistic viscous hydrodynamic theory by Bemfica, Disconzi, Noronha, and Kovtun (BDNK) in general spacetimes. We develop two independent flux-conservative algorithms for arbitrary 3+1-dimensional spacetime metrics. Both are hyperbolic, causal, and well-posed, pass convergence tests, and reproduce known results. The first uses a new first-order reduction with mathematically preserved constraints, whose numerical violations can be handled with cleaning fields (the resulting coupled system is proven hyperbolic and well-posed). The second uses a new mixed-order formulation, whose solutions are proven strictly equivalent to the original BDNK system, without cleaning fields. Our proofs rely on a new general theorem providing sufficient conditions for transforming a mixed-order system with arbitrary-order equations into a strictly hyperbolic system, strengthening a classical result by Choquet Bruhat for weak hyperbolicity. We introduce a new practical prescription for selecting admissible hydrodynamic frames for a broad class of equations of state, including nonconformal ones relevant to heavy-ion collisions and astrophysics. Our simulations capture viscous shock broadening and suppression of Kelvin--Helmholtz vortices, reproduce Bjorken and Gubser flows, and study departures from stationary ideal-fluid configurations in Michel accretion and rotating tori on fixed Schwarzschild and Kerr backgrounds. For heavy-ion collisions, we perform boost invariant simulations with a lattice-QCD-based equation of state and fluctuating TRENTo initial conditions, comparing BDNK with a minimal Israel--Stewart theory. The descriptions agree at small shear viscosity but can differ substantially at larger viscosities, particularly for early initialization with rapid longitudinal expansion.

中文摘要：Weyl几何引力理论是一种引力理论，其拉格朗日密度由Weyl曲率标量的平方与Weyl矢量强度构造。通过引入辅助标量场，并在Ricci标量与标量场之间存在非最小耦合的情况下，该理论可在Riemann几何中重写为标量-矢量-张量理论。假设Weyl矢量仅有径向分量，可由真空场方程得到精确的球对称黑洞型解；该解依赖三个任意积分常数。与Schwarzschild黑洞相比，Weyl几何引力黑洞解在径向坐标中包含线性和二次两个新项。本文的主要目标是通过研究类时测地线行为来考察Weyl几何黑洞的天体物理性质，从而探索非度规性如何影响大质量试验粒子的强场动力学以及周期轨道的拓扑结构。文中还考虑了极端质量比旋进（EMRI）系统中由此产生的引力波辐射。结果表明，Weyl几何引力中的非度规性会在轨道拓扑和紧凑EMRI系统发射的引力波形上留下独特且可测量的签名。这些独特的时间与振幅调制为在宇宙尺度上检验非度规性提供了有前景的观测途径。

English: Weyl geometric gravity theory is a gravitational theory with Lagrangian density constructed from the square of the Weyl curvature scalar and the strength of the Weyl vector. The theory can be reformulated as a scalar - vector - tensor theory in the Riemann geometry by introducing an auxiliary scalar field, in the presence of a non - minimal coupling between the Ricci scalar and the scalar field. Assuming that the Weyl vector has only a radial component, an exact spherically symmetric black hole type solution of the field equations in the vacuum can be obtained. The solution depends on three arbitrary integration constants. As compared to the case of the Schwarzschild black hole, the Weyl geometric gravity black hole solution contains two new terms, linear and quadratic, in the radial coordinate. It is the main goal of the present work to investigate astrophysical properties of the Weyl geometric black holes by considering the behavior of the timelike geodesics, which allows to explore how the geometric nonmetricity influences the strong-field dynamics of massive test particles as well as the topological structure of the periodic orbits. The resulting gravitational wave emission in extreme mass-ratio inspiral (EMRI) systems is also considered. Our results show that the presence of nonmetricity in Weyl geometric gravity leaves distinct and measurable signatures on both the orbital topology and the emitted gravitational waveforms of compact EMRI systems. These unique temporal and amplitude modulations provide a promising observational avenue for testing the presence of nonmetricity on cosmic scales.

English: We construct the Carrollian limit of minimal massive gravity. The limit is singular for the algebra and regular for the Chern-Simons-like data. The one divergent bracket points along the null direction of the contracted bilinear form. The Lagrangian is therefore finite while the brackets are not. The contracted curvature still obeys a cubic closure condition, forced on shell rather than identically. The third-way coupling itself, however, is removable. For generic parameters an invertible redefinition of the auxiliary field and the boost connection takes it to Carrollian topologically massive gravity up to a boundary term. The same redefinition fails before the limit. We solve for an anti-de Sitter vacuum and a Carrollian black hole, whose rotation parameter leaves the frame and survives only in the boost connection. The degenerate vector flavor metric obstructs the standard charge formula, which we replace by a canonical one. The boundary charges, obtained in two independent ways, carry no trace of the deformation. A Dirac analysis gives nine first-class constraints and no local degrees of freedom on any background. The massive graviton is removed. The asymptotic symmetry algebra is bms_3, with central charges carried by the Einstein and Lorentz-Chern-Simons terms. The black hole has two sets of thermodynamic data, each with its own first law. One obeys the Bekenstein-Hawking area law, the other keeps the Chern-Simons entropy.

Evan Deddo, Seppe Geukens, Leopoldo A. Pando Zayas, Christoph F. Uhlemann, Wenjie Zhou · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：4d N=4 SYM的超共形指标已显示丰富相结构，其在AdS5中的全息解释涉及（双）修饰黑洞、灰色星系和引力子气体贡献。本文将分析推广到3d CFT，聚焦ABJM理论和N=4 ADHM理论。我们研究有限N下具有两个独立荷的微正则超共形指标，并获得直至大荷的精确带符号态简并度。结果展现出大N时应出现的黑洞物理，包括孤立黑洞和被额外物质修饰的黑洞。

English: The superconformal index of 4d $\mathcal N\,{=}\,4$ SYM has been shown to exhibit a rich phase structure, whose holographic interpretation in AdS$_5$ involves (dual-)dressed black holes, gray galaxies, and graviton gas contributions. Here we extend the analysis to 3d CFTs, focusing on ABJM theory and the $\mathcal N=4$ ADHM theory. We study the microcanonical superconformal index with two independent charges at finite $N$ and obtain exact signed state degeneracies up to large charges. The results exhibit the black hole physics expected to emerge at large-$N$, including isolated black holes and black holes dressed by additional matter.

一句话导读：利用ABJM与ADHM理论的微正则超共形指标，在有限N下精确计数态简并度，并发现大N对应孤立及被物质修饰的AdS4黑洞。

香料与冰之歌：dS3 的对角对偶及其伽利略平直空间极限

A Song of Spice and Ice: A diagonal dual to dS$_3$ & its Galilean flat space limit

Arjun Bagchi, Sharang Rajesh Iyer, K. Narayan · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：本文提出一个三维渐近 de Sitter 时空的对角 CFT 对偶，它由未来边界 CFT 对偶的全纯部分与过去边界 CFT 对偶的反全纯部分构造，部分受到两个 CFT 拷贝之间对跖映射的启发。这给出全纯与反全纯扇区大小相等、符号相反的虚中心荷。相应的对角全息能动张量期望值由未来边界波函数及其复共轭构造。由此可通过 Cardy 公式恢复 dS3 的熵，并得到一族具有两个实视界的复 Kerr dS3 时空。随后探讨该 dS 构造的平直空间极限：在上述中心荷下，平直极限自然在对偶对角二维 CFT 上诱导 Galilean 收缩，而从 AdS3 趋近三维渐近平直时空时更常见的是 Carrollian 极限。该复 Kerr 族的相应极限保持内视界不变，得到与 AdS3 中 BTZ 黑洞产生的平直空间宇宙学密切相关的平直空间复黑洞，并用 BMS-Cardy 公式恢复其熵。

English: We propose a diagonal CFT dual to asymptotically de Sitter spacetimes in three dimensions (3d), constructed from the holomorphic part of the CFT dual at the future boundary and the antiholomorphic part of the CFT dual at the past boundary, in part inspired by an antipodal map between the two CFT copies. This gives equal and opposite imaginary central charges for the holomorphic and antiholomorphic sectors. The corresponding diagonal holographic energy-momentum tensor expectation values are constructed from the Wavefunction at the future boundary and its conjugate. This enables a recovery of the entropy of $dS_3$, as well as a family of complex Kerr $dS_3$ spacetimes with two real horizons, by a Cardy formula. We then explore the flatspace limit of our dS construction. With the central charges as above, the flatspace limit naturally induces a Galilean contraction on the dual diagonal 2d CFT, in contrast to the more familiar Carrollian limit when 3d Asymptotically Flat Spacetime (AFS) is approached from $AdS_3$. The corresponding limit for the complex Kerr family above leaves the inner horizon intact, resulting in flat space complex black holes ($\mathbb{C}$BH) that are closely related to flat space cosmologies which arise from BTZ black holes in AdS$_3$. We recover the entropy of these $\mathbb{C}$BHs by the BMS-Cardy formula.

一句话导读：提出 dS3 的对角 CFT 对偶，并给出其诱导 Galilean 平直空间极限及复黑洞熵的 BMS-Cardy 恢复。

反射浴与JT引力中的黑洞内部岛

Reflecting Baths and Black Hole Interior Islands in JT Gravity

Dmitry S. Ageev, Anastasia N. Zueva · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：我们研究在Jackiw-Teitelboim引力中，耦合由反射壁包围的有限非引力浴时，岛公式下纠缠熵的演化。对于自由无质量Dirac物质，我们研究纠缠熵的演化，并显式考虑反射边界诱导的关联。对于足够短的浴，无岛熵在热力学黑洞熵以下饱和，避免了与其无界增长相关的通常信息悖论。对于更大的浴，反射关联驱动外部量子极端面朝向未来视界，导致近视界外部岛支暂时消失。我们发现该支首次出现在类似scrambling的尺度，并在与浴尺寸成正比的时间重现。我们使用正则Kruskal坐标将极值化延展跨过视界，并在黑洞内部识别出真实的量子极端面。我们表明，在所研究的参数区间内，内部岛构型在外部消失的时间间隔内对辐射熵给出主导贡献，从而解决了仅用外部描述时信息悖论的重现。

English: We study the evolution of entanglement entropy within the island prescription in Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity coupled to finite non-gravitating baths bounded by reflecting walls. For free massless Dirac matter, we study the evolution of entanglement entropy, explicitly accounting for correlations induced by the reflecting boundaries. For sufficiently short baths, the no-island entropy saturates below the thermodynamic black hole entropy, avoiding the usual information paradox associated with its unbounded growth. For larger baths, reflected correlations drive the exterior quantum extremal surface toward the future horizon, leading to a temporary disappearance of the the near-horizon exterior island branch. We find that this branch first appears at a scrambling-like scale, and it reappears at a time that is proportional to the size of the bath. We extend the extremization across the horizon using regular Kruskal coordinates and identify real quantum extremal surfaces in the black hole interior. We show that, in the parameter regime studied, interior island configurations provide the dominant contribution to the radiation entropy during the exterior disappearance time interval, resolving the reappearance of the information paradox in an exterior-only description.

一句话导读：在带反射壁的有限浴中，JT引力黑洞的外部岛支可暂时消失，而内部量子极端面在信息悖论重现期间主导辐射熵。

双标度SYK中的密度核与时间量子信息探针

Density kernel and temporal quantum information probes in double-scaled SYK

Johanna Erdmenger, Maximilian Gaschler, Jonathan Karl, Arnab Kundu, Georg Setzer · hep-th, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：传统纠缠定义基于固定时间切片上的希尔伯特空间二分。近期工作利用时间关联函数构造非厄米密度核，将这一概念推广到多时刻，以编码因果响应、时间非经典性与量子动力学。我们在双标度Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（DSSYK）模型中利用其精确的弦希尔伯特空间表述构造该核，并研究由此得到的时间信息诊断量。弦空间的直和结构自然引入一种粗粒化，去除不同弦扇区之间的相干性。我们表明，相应的核度量量化信息如何在弦希尔伯特空间子区域之间动态转移。我们发现，减小λ会增强时间关联跨弦扇区的传播，以及固定扇区内的记忆损失；小λ极限下加速的时间动力学与半经典引力描述的出现相吻合。取决于弦空间划分，这些探针表现出饱和、先增长后衰减或暂时记忆损失。特征传播时间可由Krylov空间中的波前图像很好地描述，其位置依赖的跳跃参数由DSSYK的Lanczos系数决定。最后，鉴于DSSYK的量子正弦-膨胀子引力描述及其与de Sitter全息的联系，我们的结果为探测量子与半经典引力区间的时间量子关联提供了受控环境，并推动对密度核的几何解释。

English: Entanglement is conventionally defined through a Hilbert space bipartition on a fixed time slice. Recent work has generalized this notion to multiple times through a non-Hermitian density kernel constructed from temporal correlation functions, encoding causal response, temporal non-classicality and quantum dynamics. We construct this kernel in the double-scaled Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev (DSSYK) model using its exact chord Hilbert space formulation and study the resulting temporal information diagnostics. The direct sum structure of chord space naturally introduces a coarse-graining under which coherence between different chord sectors is removed. We show that the corresponding kernel measures quantify how information is dynamically transferred across subregions in the chord Hilbert space. We find that decreasing $\lambda$ enhances the propagation of temporal correlation across chord sectors, as well as the loss of memory within a fixed sector. This accelerated temporal dynamics in the small $\lambda$ limit coincides with the emergence of a semiclassical gravity description. Depending on the chord space partition, the probes exhibit either saturation, a growth followed by a decay, or temporary memory loss. The characteristic propagation time is nicely captured by a wavefront picture in Krylov space, with position-dependent hopping parameters that are determined by the DSSYK Lanczos coefficients. Finally, given the quantum sine-dilaton gravity description of DSSYK and its connections to de Sitter holography, our results provide a controlled setting for probing temporal quantum correlations across quantum and semiclassical gravitational regimes, and motivate a geometric interpretation of the density kernel.

一句话导读：在DSSYK的弦希尔伯特空间中构造时间密度核，研究跨弦扇区的时间量子信息诊断及其与半经典引力、Krylov波前的联系。

对偶于伪厄米理论的 AdS 到 dS 流

AdS to dS Flows Dual to Pseudo-Hermitian Theories

Jos\'e M. Begines, Ant\'on F. Faedo, Carlos Hoyos, Daniele Musso · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：我们构造了多于两维的“centaur”几何的推广，作为 Einstein 引力与 ghost 标量耦合的解。这些解在渐近 anti-de Sitter 与渐近 de Sitter 时空之间插值，两个渐近区域由视界分隔。全息解释是它们对偶于将实耦合和算符延拓到纯虚数值所得到的伪厄米理论。其中一族解来自一个超引力理论，该理论是具有弦论已知嵌入的一致截断。我们研究了这些解的热力学和线性稳定性，并确定了超引力解到十一维的 uplift。

English: We construct generalizations of ''centaur" geometries in more than two dimensions as solutions of Einstein gravity coupled to a ghost scalar. The solutions interpolate between asymptotically anti-de Sitter and asymptotically de Sitter spacetimes, with the two asymptotic regions separated by a horizon. A holographic interpretation is that they are dual to pseudo-Hermitian theories obtained from the continuation of real couplings and operators to purely imaginary values. One family of solutions is obtained from a supergravity theory that is a consistent truncation with a known embedding in string theory. We study the thermodynamic and linear stability of the solutions, and determine the uplift of the supergravity solutions to eleven dimensions.

一句话导读：构造 AdS 到 dS 的 centaur 型经典引力解，并解释为伪厄米全息对偶，研究热力学与线性稳定性。

膨胀宇宙中强一阶相变产生的引力波

Gravitational waves from strong first-order phase transitions in an expanding Universe

Jintao Zou, Zizhuo Zhao, Yongtao Jia, Ligong Bian · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：本文研究膨胀宇宙中一阶相变产生的引力波。作者采用标量场-流体耦合模型，对强强度慢速一阶相变进行三维格点数值模拟。观测到声波对引力波信号的贡献显著主导于气泡碰撞贡献。声波谱在平均气泡间距和声壳宽度处呈现两个峰。气泡碰撞过程中流体内产生旋转模式，其幅度随相变强度 α 增大。声波源的有效寿命在较慢相变中增加，在具有更大 β/H 的较快相变中减少，并随较小 α 上升。模拟得到的归一化引力波幅度为 O(10^-2)，与 Minkowski 时空结果一致，但所得引力波谱与那些情形明显不同。

English: We investigate the gravitational waves generated by first-order phase transitions (PTs) in an expanding Universe. Using a scalar field-fluid coupled model, we perform three-dimensional lattice numerical simulations of slow first-order PTs with strong strength. We observe that the contribution from sound waves to the gravitational wave (GW) signal significantly dominates over that from bubble collisions. The sound wave spectra exhibit two peaks located at the mean bubble separation and the sound-shell width. Rotational modes are generated in the fluid during the bubble collisions, and their magnitude grows with the PT strength ($\alpha$). The effective lifetime of the sound-wave source increases for slower PTs, decreasing for faster PT with larger $\beta/H$ and rising with smaller $\alpha$. While the simulated amplitude of normalized gravitational waves is of order $\mathcal{O}(10^{-2})$, in alignment with Minkowski-spacetime results, the resulting GW spectra differ markedly from those scenarios.

一句话导读：三维格点模拟表明，膨胀宇宙中强一阶相变的引力波主要由声波而非气泡碰撞贡献，且谱形与 Minkowski 情形显著不同。

LISA随机引力波背景推断中的残余银河双星前景：源功率集中与谱简并

Residual Galactic binary foreground in LISA stochastic gravitational-wave background inference: source power concentration and spectral degeneracy

Ruo-Yu Guan, Yan Wang · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：银河致密双星预期构成LISA毫赫兹频段的主导前景，其残余功率可能偏置随机引力波背景（SGWB）推断或增大其不确定度。利用LISA Data Challenge 2A（LDC2A）注入和Erebor注入-恢复匹配，我们在0.4至6.0 mHz构造目录残余谱，并区分两种效应：一是独立随机相位源信号之和偏离高斯性，用超额峰度量化；二是残余与SGWB在分bin平均功率中的谱简并。源离散性决定该和的超额峰度，但仪器噪声和基准SGWB功率在多数bin中显著降低其幅度。我们用对SGWB幅度Ω0和残余功率因子β的局部Fisher信息矩阵量化简并。对于频率无关SGWB，取Ω0=10^-11且残余功率在每个bin内均匀分布于傅里叶频率时，边际化β使Ω0不确定度在Gaussian Fourier-amplitude协方差下增加13.6%，在有限源对角随机相位协方差下增加13.8%。在Gaussian Fourier-amplitude协方差下，将增加限制在10%所允许的β先验标准差最大为0.0073。若在每个基准幅度处重算协方差，则在10^-13≤Ω0≤10^-10范围内不确定度增加为12.7%至20.7%。残余-SGWB谱简并在残余功率于傅里叶频率的替代分布和对角协方差下仍存在，而忽略残余会在拟合的SGWB幅度中引入系统偏置。

English: Galactic compact binaries are expected to form a dominant millihertz foreground for the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA), and residual foreground power can bias stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) inference or increase its uncertainty. Using the LISA Data Challenge 2A (LDC2A) injections and the Erebor injection-recovery match, we construct a catalog residual spectrum from 0.4 to 6.0 mHz. We distinguish two effects. The first is the departure from Gaussianity of a sum of source signals with independent random phases, quantified by its excess kurtosis; the second is the spectral degeneracy between the residual and the SGWB in the mean binned power. Source discreteness determines the excess kurtosis of this sum, but instrumental noise and fiducial SGWB power strongly reduce its magnitude in most bins. We quantify this degeneracy with a local Fisher information matrix for the SGWB amplitude $\Omega_0$ and the residual-power factor $\beta$. For a frequency-independent SGWB with $\Omega_0=10^{-11}$ and residual power distributed uniformly over the Fourier frequencies within each bin, marginalizing over $\beta$ increases the $\Omega_0$ uncertainty by $13.6\%$ with the Gaussian Fourier-amplitude covariance and by $13.8\%$ with the finite-source diagonal random-phase covariance. Under the Gaussian Fourier-amplitude covariance, the largest allowed prior standard deviation on $\beta$ that limits this increase to $10\%$ is $0.0073$. With this covariance recomputed at each fiducial amplitude, the uncertainty increase ranges from $12.7\%$ to $20.7\%$ over $10^{-13}\leq\Omega_0\leq10^{-10}$. The residual-SGWB spectral degeneracy persists under alternative distributions of residual power over Fourier frequencies and diagonal covariances, while omitting the residual induces a systematic bias in the fitted SGWB amplitude.

一句话导读：量化LISA银河双星残余前景与SGWB的谱简并对Ω0推断的影响，并给出Fisher矩阵误差估计。

太阳风等离子体噪声对基于空间干涉仪网络的随机引力波背景搜索的影响

Effects of Solar Wind Plasma Noise on Stochastic Gravitational Wave Background Searches with a Space Based Interferometer Network

Mengfei Sun, Borui Wang, Jie Wu, Jin Li, Shengyi Ye · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：LISA-Taiji 双探测器网络通过交叉相关测量提升毫赫兹随机引力波背景（SGWB）灵敏度。然而，太阳风等离子体可产生探测器间相关的等离子体噪声，并偏置 SGWB 交叉相关估计。我们使用 Wind/SWE 的高时间分辨率电子密度数据，用 Lomb-Scargle 方法估计太阳风电子密度涨落谱，并将所得等离子体噪声传播到 LISA-Taiji 网络的 TDI A/E 通道。通过纳入有限臂传播、Taylor 冻结流空间相关和网络重叠约化响应，我们计算了探测器间等离子体噪声引起的 SGWB 参数偏置。虽然单探测器等离子体残差低于参考噪声，但探测器间相关分量可直接进入 SGWB 交叉相关估计器。在双探测器尺度覆盖下，对幂律 SGWB，等离子体引起的参数偏置可达相应 Fisher 参数不确定度的 12.73%。对于 M2/M3 宇宙弦谱，在所考虑的网络构型、观测时间和频段下，ln Gμ 的偏置可达相应 Fisher 参数不确定度的 19.26%。这些结果表明，太阳风等离子体噪声的影响不能仅从单探测器残差噪声水平评估。在 LISA-Taiji SGWB 搜索中，该噪声的探测器间相关分量可直接影响参数估计。

English: The LISA-Taiji dual detector network improves millihertz SGWB sensitivity through cross correlation measurements. Solar wind plasma, however, can generate plasma noise correlated between detectors and bias SGWB cross correlation estimates. We use high time resolution electron density data from Wind/SWE, estimate the solar wind electron density fluctuation spectrum with the Lomb-Scargle method, and propagate the resulting plasma noise to the TDI A/E channels of the LISA-Taiji network. By including finite arm propagation, Taylor frozen flow spatial correlations, and the network overlap reduction response, we compute the SGWB parameter bias induced by interdetector plasma noise. Although the single detector plasma residual is below the reference noise, the component correlated between detectors can enter the SGWB cross correlation estimator directly. Under dual detector scale coverage, the plasma induced parameter bias for a power law SGWB can reach $12.73\%$ of the corresponding Fisher parameter uncertainty. For M2/M3 cosmic string spectra, the bias in $\ln G\mu$ can reach $19.26\%$ of the corresponding Fisher parameter uncertainty for the network configurations, observing times, and frequency bands considered here. These results show that the impact of solar wind plasma noise cannot be assessed from the single detector residual noise level alone. In LISA-Taiji SGWB searches, the interdetector correlated component of this noise can directly affect parameter estimation.

一句话导读：LISA-Taiji 网络中太阳风等离子体噪声的探测器间相关分量会偏置随机引力波背景参数估计，且不能由单探测器残差水平评估。

平移对称 Einstein--标量--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中绕旋转黑洞白矮星的准平衡潮汐折叠

Quasi-equilibrium tidal folds of white dwarfs around rotating black holes in shift-symmetric Einstein--scalar--Gauss--Bonnet gravity

Shoupan Liu, Meilin Liu, Yu Wang, Yunqi Liu, Bin Wang · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：我们研究在线性、平移对称 Einstein--标量--Gauss--Bonnet（EsGB）引力中，旋转黑洞的几何如何改变白矮星的极限潮汐平衡。相对论潮汐场由数值 EsGB 背景在平行移动标架中获得，并与可压缩仿射模型耦合。与在 ADM 质量和角动量上匹配的 Kerr 黑洞比较显示，潮汐折叠处的轨道频率出现正移。固定自旋下，相对修正近似随 EsGB 耦合呈二次依赖，这与度规对标量场的领头响应一致。在所采样背景上，相对修正达到 10^{-3} 量级。黑洞旋转也改变潮汐折叠与最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）的关系：采样的顺行折叠仍位于 ISCO 外，而逆行折叠在较高自旋下进入 ISCO 内。因此轨道方向控制潮汐平衡是否在轨道稳定性极限之前丧失。对于本文考虑的恒星和黑洞质量，特征引力波频率落在计划空间干涉仪相关的毫赫兹波段。未来能够分辨 Kerr 偏离的引力波观测可限制 EsGB 耦合。

English: We examine how the geometry of rotating black holes in linear, shift-symmetric Einstein--scalar--Gauss--Bonnet (EsGB) gravity changes the limiting tidal equilibria of white dwarfs (WDs). The relativistic tidal field is obtained from numerical EsGB backgrounds in a parallel-transported frame and coupled to a compressible affine model. Comparisons with Kerr black holes matched in Arnowitt--Deser--Misner (ADM) mass and angular momentum show a positive shift in the orbital frequency at the tidal fold. At fixed spin the relative correction follows an approximately quadratic dependence on the EsGB coupling, consistent with the leading response of the metric to the scalar field. Over the sampled backgrounds, the relative correction reaches order $10^{-3}$. Black hole rotation also changes the relation between the tidal fold and the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO): the sampled prograde folds remain outside the ISCO, while retrograde folds move inside it at higher spins. Orbital orientation therefore controls whether tidal equilibrium is lost before the orbital stability limit is reached. For the stellar and black hole masses considered here, the characteristic gravitational wave (GW) frequencies fall in the millihertz band relevant to planned space based interferometers. Future GW observations capable of resolving deviations from Kerr predictions could constrain the EsGB coupling.

一句话导读：该文用数值 EsGB 旋转黑洞背景与可压缩仿射模型研究白矮星潮汐折叠，并讨论其对 EsGB 耦合和毫赫兹引力波的约束意义。

动态 Chern-Simons 引力中 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞轴向准正规模的等谱性破缺

Isospectrality breaking in the axial quasinormal modes of Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity

Abhishek Rout · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：我们研究动态 Chern-Simons 引力中 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞的奇宇称微扰。dCS 作用量因 ϑ *RR 是两个赝标量的乘积而具有宇称不变性；然而赝标量微扰具有奇宇称，在线性阶只进入轴向扇区，从而破除广义相对论中的轴向-极向等谱性。我们直接从线性化场方程推导有限电荷下赝标量与轴向引力及电磁微扰之间的耦合。两个方向均由径向核 (Mr-Q^2)Δ/r^8 支配；在非零电荷时赝标量耦合到 Ψ+χΨ_e，其中 χ=2Q/[r√((l-1)(l+2))]。在对 Einstein-Maxwell 扇区对角化后，我们用外复标度计算光子球模的分支分辨准正规模移动，并用 Frobenius 打靶法处理近极端零阻尼模。对 Schwarzschild l=2 基模得到 β δω=-0.7733-0.3946 i（单位 M=α=1）。非共振时，引力主导的移动在 Q=0 按 ζ l^3 标度，但在固定非零电荷大 l 下按 ζ l^2/Q 标度。电磁主导分支在 Q_c=2M√(l(l+1)+1)/[l(l+1)+2] 处与赝标量模精确简并，此时赝标量势与电磁主导势的极向伙伴重合；该处破缺为 O(√ζ)，l=2 时 M|Δω|≈2.4√ζ，且移动在 Q_c 两侧反号。近极端时，光子球移动保持有限，而非简并的引力主导零阻尼基模被压低，l=2 时 δω/ω≈6.0×10^3 ζ (1-Q^2/M^2)。

English: We study odd-parity perturbations of Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity. The dCS action is parity invariant because $\vartheta\,{}^{*}RR$ is the product of two pseudoscalars; nevertheless, the pseudoscalar perturbation has odd parity and enters only the axial sector at linear order and so lifts the axial--polar isospectrality of general relativity. We derive the finite-charge couplings between the pseudoscalar and the axial gravitational and electromagnetic perturbations directly from the linearized field equations. Both directions are governed by the radial kernel $(Mr-Q^2)\Delta/r^8$, and at nonzero charge the pseudoscalar couples to $\Psi+\chi\Psi_e$, with $\chi=2Q/[r\sqrt{(l-1)(l+2)}]$. After diagonalizing the Einstein--Maxwell sector, we compute branch-resolved quasinormal-mode shifts with exterior complex scaling for the photon-sphere modes and Frobenius shooting for the near-extremal zero-damping modes. For the Schwarzschild $l=2$ fundamental mode we obtain $\beta\,\delta\omega=-0.7733-0.3946\,i$ (units $M=\alpha=1$). Off resonance, the gravitational-led shift scales as $\zeta\,l^3$ at $Q=0$ but as $\zeta\,l^2/Q$ at fixed nonzero charge and large $l$. The electromagnetic-led branch becomes exactly degenerate with the pseudoscalar mode at $Q_c=2M\sqrt{l(l+1)+1}/[l(l+1)+2]$, where the pseudoscalar potential coincides with the polar partner of the electromagnetic-led potential; there the breaking is $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt\zeta)$, $M|\Delta\omega|\simeq2.4\sqrt\zeta$ for $l=2$, and the shift reverses sign across $Q_c$. Near extremality the photon-sphere shifts remain finite, whereas the non-degenerate fundamental gravitational-led zero-damping mode is suppressed, $\delta\omega/\omega\simeq6.0\times10^{3}\,\zeta\,(1-Q^2/M^2)$ for $l=2$.

旋转减缓 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞的不稳定性

Rotation slows the instability of Ellis-Bronnikov wormholes

Nikita M. Shirokov, Ilya Nachevsky · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v2 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：旋转在慢旋转微扰理论中削弱 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞的径向不稳定性。我们通过演化由幽灵标量场支撑的稳态旋转 drainholes 来研究其非线性效应。我们用独立的谱求解器构造背景，并用已发表的对称解进行验证，同时指出一篇已发表场方程中的印刷错误，该错误未影响原作者的数值结果。仅受离散化误差扰动的演化表明旋转减缓坍缩。在中等自旋下，一些喉部会膨胀，偏离方向取决于有效微扰。在演化到的最快自旋下，喉部面积半径在代码单位 t=150（约静态不稳定性的 28 个 e-folding 时间）内、在三个分辨率下均未显示增长性偏离。另外两个快速旋转模型在其可靠演化区间内也未显示增长。坍缩的旋转喉部发出轴对称四极引力波暴，其能量在比较的两个自旋之间增加。二阶初始数据通过其背景截断误差激发不稳定性。结果确立了在所采样的非对称背景下、从初始轴对称数据出发的有限时间内，坍缩更慢以及未检测到径向增长的持续时间延长。

English: Rotation weakens the radial instability of Ellis-Bronnikov wormholes in slow-rotation perturbation theory. We investigate its nonlinear effect by evolving stationary rotating drainholes supported by a phantom scalar field. We construct the backgrounds with an independent spectral solver, validate them against published symmetric solutions, and identify a misprint in a published field equation that did not affect the original authors' numerical results. Evolutions perturbed only by discretization error show that rotation slows the collapse. At intermediate spins some throats expand, with the direction of departure depending on the effective perturbation. At the fastest evolved spin, the throat's areal radius shows no growing departure through evolution time $t=150$ in code units, about 28 e-folding times of the static instability, at three resolutions. Two other rapidly rotating models also show no growth over their reliable evolution intervals. Collapsing rotating throats emit an axisymmetric quadrupolar gravitational-wave burst whose energy increases between the two spins compared. Second-order initial data excite the instability through their background truncation error. The results establish slower collapse and prolonged absence of detected radial growth for the sampled asymmetric backgrounds, over finite times from initially axisymmetric data.

一句话导读：在慢旋转微扰与非线性数值演化中，旋转减缓 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞的径向坍缩不稳定性，并在有限演化时间内抑制喉部增长。

脉冲星计时阵列中引力波记忆探测的最优策略与噪声边缘化

Optimal Strategies for Gravitational-Wave Memory Detection with Noise Marginalization in Pulsar Timing Arrays

Rand Burnette, Xavier Siemens · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v2 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：当前脉冲星计时阵列有可能探测到引力波记忆，这将为广义相对论提供独特检验。为优化脉冲星计时阵列中引力波记忆的搜寻，作者将引力波记忆的最优频率派统计量集成到 enterprise 代码套件中，并测试了该统计量的噪声边缘化版本，比较其与更简单的最大后验方法的有效性。他们在包含红噪声和白噪声的模拟脉冲星计时阵列以及 NANOGrav 15 年数据集上进行了测试。发现在模拟数据集中，噪声边缘化方法与最大后验方法之间的探测统计量没有显著差异；在 NANOGrav 15 年数据比较中仅有小差异。作者结论是，对于现实脉冲星计时阵列，噪声边缘化方法可用于为贝叶斯结果分配误报概率，而最大后验方法足以识别潜在可探测信号。

English: Current pulsar timing arrays could detect gravitational wave memory, which would provide a unique test of general relativity. In order to optimize our searches for gravitational wave memory in pulsar timing arrays, we integrate the optimal frequentist statistics for GW memory into the \texttt{enterprise} code suite. We additionally test a noise marginalized version of this statistic, and compare it's effectiveness to the simpler maximum posterior method. We perform these tests on simulated pulsar timing array with red and white noise content, as well as the NANOGrav $15$-year data set. We find no significant variations in our detection statistics between the noise-marginalized and the maximum-posterior methods for the simulated datasets, and only small variations in the NANOGrav $15$-year comparisons. We conclude that for realistic PTAs the noise-marginalization method could be useful for assigning a false alarm probability to Bayesian results, though the maximum posterior method is sufficient for identifying potentially detectable signals.

一句话导读：该文比较脉冲星计时阵列中引力波记忆探测的噪声边缘化与最大后验统计方法，并评估其在模拟数据和 NANOGrav 15 年数据中的表现。

约束 GW250114 中的二次模振幅耦合

Constraining the Quadratic-mode Amplitude Coupling in GW250114

Yuxin Yang, Changfu Shi, Yi-Ming Hu · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v2 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：在黑洞铃宕中探测二次准正规模将为非线性引力动力学提供证据，而测量其性质可检验广义相对论的相应预言。具体而言，二阶黑洞微扰理论预言其振幅与母线性模振幅乘积成正比，耦合系数依赖于遗迹黑洞自旋。该模式特定耦合系数尚未从引力波数据直接测得。本文对 GW250114 铃宕使用贝叶斯推断，以 220、221 和 220×220 模式建模，推断 220×220 模式的振幅耦合系数。推断系数与数值相对论拟合及二阶微扰理论预言一致；没有比较显示超过 1.3σ 的偏离。尽管当前数据无法区分这些依赖自旋的预言，该测量为更严格观测检验黑洞铃宕中的非线性引力动力学奠定基础。

English: Detecting quadratic quasi-normal modes in black hole ringdowns would provide evidence for nonlinear gravitational dynamics, while measuring their properties would enable tests of the corresponding predictions of general relativity. Specifically, second-order black hole perturbation theory predicts that their amplitudes scale with the product of the amplitudes of their parent linear modes, with a coupling coefficient that depends on the spin of the remnant black hole. This mode-specific coupling coefficient has not yet been directly measured from gravitational wave data. Here, we use Bayesian inference on the GW250114 ringdown, modeled with the $220$, $221$, and $220\times220$ modes, to infer the amplitude-coupling coefficient of the $220\times220$ mode. The inferred coefficient is consistent with predictions from numerical relativity fits and second-order perturbation theory; no comparison shows a deviation exceeding $1.3 \sigma$. Although the current data cannot distinguish among these spin-dependent predictions, this measurement establishes a basis for more stringent observational tests of nonlinear gravitational dynamics in black-hole ringdowns.

一句话导读：利用 GW250114 铃宕数据贝叶斯推断 220×220 二次准正规模的振幅耦合系数，结果与数值相对论和二阶微扰理论预言一致。

范德瓦尔斯黑洞的周期轨道

Periodic Orbits of Van der Waals Black Holes

Xuyao Gong, Zhaoyi Xu, Meirong Tang · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：渐近反德西特（AdS）时空中，其扩展相空间热力学精确重现范德瓦尔斯流体的黑洞构成一类独特对象，即范德瓦尔斯黑洞（VBHs）。本文求解VBH的类时测地线，编目其周期轨道，并计算沿这些轨道发射的引力波，以追踪热力学压强P和分子体积参数b如何塑造轨道动力学。通过数值积分测地线方程，得到最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）的能量、角动量和半径，并绘出束缚轨道族。为界定有效势保持良好行为的参数窗口，我们引入临界角动量Ls。在轨道分类方案内，对若干参数集计算对应于有理数q的能量，并展示所得轨道。沿这些轨道产生的波形在“Kludge”形式框架内生成，从而可量化b对波幅和周期的影响。轨道结构和引力波信号均对b高度敏感。VBHs与Schwarzschild-AdS（SAdS）黑洞的动力学行为显著不同，为通过引力波观测探测黑洞热力学提供了新视角。

English: Black holes in asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime whose extended-phase-space thermodynamics reproduces that of a van der Waals fluid exactly form a distinctive class, the van der Waals black holes (VBHs). The timelike geodesics of VBHs are solved, their periodic orbits are catalogued, and the gravitational waves emitted along them are computed, so as to trace how the thermodynamic pressure P and the molecular-volume parameter b shape the orbital dynamics. Integrating the geodesic equations numerically yields the energy, angular momentum and radius of the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) and maps out the family of bound orbits. To delimit the parameter window in which the effective potential stays well behaved, we introduce a critical angular momentum Ls. Within the orbit-classification scheme, we compute the energies corresponding to rational q for several parameter sets and display the resulting orbits. The waveforms produced along these orbits are generated within the "Kludge" formalism, which makes it possible to quantify the imprint of b on the wave amplitude and on the period. Both the orbital architecture and the gravitational-wave signature turn out to be strongly sensitive to b. The dynamical behavior of VBHs and Schwarzschild-AdS (SAdS) black holes differs markedly, providing a new perspective for probing black hole thermodynamics via gravitational wave observations.

Schwarzschild-(反)de Sitter时空中自旋粒子的解析运动

Analytic motions of spinning particles in Schwarzschild-(anti-)de Sitter spacetime

Rui-Hui Lin, Xing-You Zhou, Chao-Jun Feng · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：在Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon形式体系下，在线性自旋阶研究静态球对称含宇宙学常数时空中自旋测试粒子的运动。利用背景对称性将径向和纬向动力学约化为一阶方程，并由自旋形变五次多项式控制。完整分类该五次多项式的实根结构，得到Schwarzschild-anti-de Sitter和Schwarzschild-de Sitter几何中允许的轨道类型；分析根结构和稳定圆轨道区间对参数的依赖。特别地，当宇宙学常数超过Stuchlík极限、无自旋粒子无束缚轨道时，自旋粒子仍可保持束缚。径向运动用Lauricella超几何函数分段表示，五次多项式的简单正实根作为分支割线；纬向运动为赤道面附近小振荡，其相位由同一五次多项式控制并具有类似解析表示。

English: The motion of a spinning test particle in a static, spherically symmetric spacetime with a cosmological constant is studied within the Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon formalism, working to linear order in the particle's spin. By exploiting the symmetries of the background, the radial and latitudinal dynamics are reduced to first-order equations governed by a spin-deformed quintic polynomial. A complete classification of the real root structure of this quintic is carried out, from which the allowed orbital types for spinning particles in the Schwarzschild-anti-de Sitter and Schwarzschild-de Sitter geometries follow directly. The parameter dependence of the root structure and of the stable circular orbit interval is analyzed. In particular, for values of the cosmological constant beyond the Stuchl\'ik limit, where spinless particles admit no bound orbits, spinning particles can still remain bound. The radial motion is expressed piecewise in terms of Lauricella hypergeometric functions, with the simple positive real roots of the quintic acting as branch cuts. The latitudinal motion consists of small oscillations about an equatorial plane, and its phase, governed by the same quintic, admits an analogous analytic representation.

一句话导读：用Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon形式与五次多项式根分类，解析研究Schwarzschild-(A)dS时空中线性自旋测试粒子的轨道结构。

Schwarzschild时空中自旋粒子的精确动力学与自旋墙

Exact dynamics of spinning particles and the spin wall in Schwarzschild spacetime

Chao-Jun Feng, Rui-Hui Lin · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-11-09

中文摘要：本文在Schwarzschild时空中研究赤道面、自旋对齐的测试自旋粒子运动，在Tulczyjew--Dixon条件下求解Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon方程至自旋的所有阶。通过消去四速度，系统化为闭合代数形式并约化为单个一阶径向方程。作者追踪两个运动学质量、四动量的模及其在速度上的投影，发现代表性世界线在半径、自旋和角动量空间中的某个面上不再类时，称之为“自旋墙”。该面限制自旋粒子可及半径，除纯径向族外对所有非零动量角分量存在；其位置有闭合表达式，可位于视界内、包围视界或到达外部。文中还考察极偶极截断在自旋墙可及时的可控性，并确定圆轨道及其稳定性、边缘稳定轨道随自旋的变化，以及超出自旋一阶的近日点进动。

English: The motion of a spinning test body is governed by the Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon equations and deviates from geodesics already at first order in the spin. Most studies of this problem truncate the dynamics at linear order; here we solve the equatorial, spin-aligned problem in Schwarzschild spacetime at all orders in the spin under the Tulczyjew--Dixon condition. Eliminating the four-velocity casts the system into a closed algebraic form and reduces the motion to a single first-order radial equation. Keeping track of both kinematical masses, the norm of the four-momentum and its projection on the velocity, we find that the representative worldline ceases to be timelike on a surface in the space of radius, spin and angular momentum. We call this surface the spin wall. It bounds the radii accessible to a spinning body and is present for every nonvanishing value of the momentum's angular component; only for the purely radial family does it collapse, and that family moves on a geodesic. Its position follows in closed form and may lie inside the horizon, enclose it, or reach the exterior, the last possibility arising already at small spin. We also examine how far the pole--dipole truncation remains under control where the wall is accessible. Within that regime we determine the circular orbits and their stability, the spin dependence of the marginally stable orbit, and the perihelion advance beyond first order in the spin.
